group.title: Upon Waking Up
group.version: When we just woke up

doua.arabic: اَلحَمدُ لِلهِ الَّذِي أحيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أمَاتَنَا وَ إِلَيهِ النُّشُورُ
doua.translation: « Praise is to Allah Who gives us life after He has caused us to die and to Him is the return »
doua.reference: Al-Bukhari (#6312), see Fatḥ al-Bari (11/113), and Muslim (#2711, 4/2083).
doua.phonetic: Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi l-ladhî a<u>h</u>yânâ ba'da mâ amâtanâ wa ilayhi n-noushoûr.

doua.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالحَمدُ للهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
doua.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things. Glory is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. There is none worthy of worship but Allah. Allah is the Most Great. There is no might and no power except by Allah's leave, the Exalted, the Mighty. My Lord, forgive me. (Whoever says this will be forgiven, and if he supplicates to Allah, his prayer will be answered; if he performs ablution and prays, his prayer will be accepted.)
doua.reference: Al-Bukhari (#1154), see Fatḥ al-Bari (3/39). The wording is of Ibn Majah (#3878), also see saḥiḥ Ibn Majah (2/335).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou l<u>h</u>amdou, wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay’in qadîr. Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi, wa-l-<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi, wa lâ ilâha illa l-lâhou, wa l-lâhou akbarou, wa lâ <u>h</u>awla wa lâ qouwwata illa billâhi-l-'aliyyi-l-'azîm. Rabbi ghfir lî.

doua.arabic: الحَمدُ للهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
doua.translation: « Praise is to Allah Who gave strength to my body, He returned my soul to me and permitted me to remember Him. »
doua.reference: Al-Tirmidhi (#3401, 5/473), also see saḥiḥ Al-Tirmidhi (3/144).
doua.phonetic: Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi l-ladhî 'âfânî fî jasadî wa radda 'alayya roû<u>h</u>î, wa adhina lî bi-dhikrihi.

doua.arabic: يقرأ سورة آل عمران ٣ : ١٩٠-٢٠٠ - إِنَّ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ﴿١٩٠﴾ ٱلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ قِيَٰمًۭا وَقُعُودًۭا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلًۭا سُبْحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ﴿١٩١﴾ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُۥ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍۢ ﴿١٩٢﴾ رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًۭا يُنَادِى لِلْإِيمَٰنِ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٣﴾ رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ ﴿١٩٤﴾فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّى لَآ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَٰمِلٍۢ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ ۖ بَعْضُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ وَأُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَٰرِهِمْ وَأُوذُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِى وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ وَقُتِلُوا۟ لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ثَوَابًۭا مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلثَّوَابِ ﴿١٩٥﴾ لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ ﴿١٩٦﴾ مَتَٰعٌۭ قَلِيلٌۭ ثُمَّ مَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ ﴿١٩٧﴾ لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًۭا مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ لِّلْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٨﴾ وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَٰشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًا ۗ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ ﴿١٩٩﴾ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱصْبِرُوا۟ وَصَابِرُوا۟ وَرَابِطُوا۟ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴿٢٠٠﴾
doua.translation: Recite Surah al 'Imran (3:190--200) : (190) Verily! In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, there are indeed signs for men of understanding. (191) Those who remember Allah (always, and in prayers) standing, sitting, and lying down on their sides, and think deeply about the creation of the heavens and the earth, (saying): "Our Lord! You have not created (all) this without purpose, glory to You! (Exalted be You above all that they associate with You as partners). Give us salvation from the torment of the Fire. (192) "Our Lord! Verily, whom You admit to the Fire, indeed, You have disgraced him, and never will the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers) find any helpers. (193) "Our Lord! Verily, we have heard the call of one (Muhammad SAW) calling to Faith: 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die in the state of righteousness along with Al-Abrar (those who are obedient to Allah and follow strictly His Orders). (194) "Our Lord! Grant us what You promised unto us through Your Messengers and disgrace us not on the Day of Resurrection, for You never break (Your) Promise." (195) So their Lord accepted of them (their supplication and answered them), "Never will I allow to be lost the work of any of you, be he male or female. You are (members) one of another, so those who emigrated and were driven out from their homes, and suffered harm in My Cause, and who fought, and were killed (in My Cause), verily, I will remit from them their evil deeds and admit them into Gardens under which rivers flow (in Paradise); a reward from Allah, and with Allah is the best of rewards." (196) Land not the free disposal (and affluence) of the disbelievers throughout the land deceive you. (197) A brief enjoyment; then, their ultimate abode is Hell; and worst indeed is that place for rest. (198) But, for those who fear their Lord, are Gardens under which rivers flow (in Paradise); therein are they to dwell (for ever), an entertainment from Allah; and that which is with Allah is the Best for Al-Abrar (those who are obedient to Allah and follow strictly His Orders). (199) And there are, certainly, among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians), those who believe in Allah and in that which has been revealed to you, and in that which has been revealed to them, humbling themselves before Allah. They do not sell the Verses of Allah for a little price, for them is a reward with their Lord. Surely, Allah is Swift in account. (200) O you who believe! Endure and be more patient (than your enemy), and guard your territory by stationing army units permanently at the places from where the enemy can attack you, and fear Allah, so that you may be successful. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#4572), voir Fath al-Bari (8/237) and Muslim (#763, 1/530).
doua.phonetic:
Inna fî khalqi s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi wa khtilâfi l-layli wa n-nahâri la-âyâtin li-ûli-l-albâb. (190) Al-ladhîna yadhkouroûna l-lâha qiyâman wa qou'oûdan wa 'alâ jounûbihim, wa yatafakkaroûna fî khalqi s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi, rabbanâ ! mâ khalaqta hâdhâ bâtilan Soubhânaka fa-qinâ 'adhâba n-nâr. (191) Rabbanâ ! Innaka man toudkhili n-nâra fa-qad akhzaytahou wa mâ li-zâlimîna min ansâr. (192) Rabbanâ ! Innanâ sami'nâ mounâdiyan younâdî li-l-îmâni an âminû bi-rabbikoum fa-âmannâ. (193) Rabbanâ ! Fa-ghfir lanâ dhounûbanâ wa kaffir 'annâ sayyi âtinâ wa tawaffanâ ma'a-l-abrâr. (194) Rabbanâ ! Wa âtinâ mâ wa'adtanâ 'alâ rouSoulika wa lâ toukhzinâ yawma-l-qiyâmati, innaka lâ toukhlifou-l-mî'âd. (195) Fa-stajâba lahoum rabbouhoum annî lâ udî'ou 'amala 'âmilin minkoum m-min dhakarin aw unthâ, ba'doukoum min ba'din, fa-l-ladhîna hâjaroû wa ukhrijû min diyârihim wa ûdhoû fî sabîlî wa qâtalû wa qoutilû, la-ukaffiranna 'anhoum sayyi âtihim wa la-udkhilannahoum jannâtin tajrî min tahtihâ-l-anhârou, thawâban min 'indi l-lâhi, wa l-lâhou 'indahou husnou-ththawâb.
(196) Lâ yaghourrannaka taqalloubou l-ladhîna kafaroû fî-l-bilâd, matâ' qalîloun, thoumma ma wâhoum jahannamou wa bi sa-l-mihâd. (197) Lâkini l-ladhîna t-taqaw rabbahoum lahoum jannâtoun tajrî min tahâ-l-anhârou khâlidîna fîhâ, nouzulan m-min 'indi l-lâhi wa mâ 'inda l-lâhi khayroun li-l-abrâr. (198) Wa inna min ahli-l-kitâbi la-man you minou billâhi wa mâ unzila ilaykoum wa mâ unzila ilayhim, khâshi'îna li-l-lâhi, lâ yashtaroûna bi-âyâti l-lâhi thamanan qalîlan. Uwlâ-ika lahoum ajrouhoum 'inda rabbihim, inna l-l^haa sarî'-l-hisâb. (199) Yâ ayyouhâ l-ladhîna âmanû-sbiroû wa sâbiroû wa râbitû wa t-taqû l-lâha la'allakoum touflihûn. (200)

group.title: When wearing clothes

doua.arabic: اَلحَمدُ للهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا (الثَّوْبَ) وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَولٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
doua.translation: « Praise is to Allah Who has clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me, though I was powerless myself and incapable. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#4023) and the wording is his, at-Tirmidhi (#2458) and Ibn Majah (#3285). Also see Irwa' al-Ghalil (7/47).
doua.phonetic: Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi l-ladhî kasânî hadhâ th-thawbawa razaqanîhi min ghayri <u>h</u>awlin minnî wa lâ qouwwatin.

group.title: When wearing new clothes

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشِّرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it (i.e. the garment), I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#4020) and at-Tirmidhi (#1767) and al-Baghawi. Cette version est de Abu Dawud. Also see moukhtasar Shamaʾil at-Tirmidhi par al-Albani (p.47).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma laka-l-<u>h</u>amdou. Anta kasawtanîhi. As’alouka min khayrihi wa khayri mâ <u>s</u>ouni'a lahou, wa a'oudhou bika min sharrihi wa sharri mâ <u>s</u>ouni'a lahou.

group.title: Said to someone wearing new clothes

doua.arabic: تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللهُ تَعَالَى
doua.translation: « May you wear it out and Allah replace it (with another). »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#4020, 4/41). Also see Sahih Abi Dawud (2/760).
doua.phonetic: toublî wa youkhlifou l-lâhou ta'âlâ.

doua.arabic: إِلبَسْ جَدِيداً، وَعِشْ حَمِيداً، وَمُتْ شَهِيداً
doua.translation: « Wear anew, live commendably and die a martyr. »
doua.reference: Ibn Majah (#3558, 2/1178) and al-Baghawi (12/41). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/275).
doua.phonetic: Ilbas jadîdan, wa 'îsh <u>h</u>amîdan, wa mout shahîdan.

group.title: Before undressing

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#606, 2/505) and Sahih al-Jami' (#3210, 3/203). Also see Irwa' al-Ghalil (#50).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi.

group.title: Before entering the toilet

doua.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللهِ) اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
doua.translation: « (In the name of Allah). O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#142, 1/45) and Muslim (#375, 1/283). The version with (Au nom d'Allah) is mentioned by Sa'id bin Mansour, voir Fath al-Bari (1/244).
doua.phonetic: (Bismillâhi). Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika mina-l-khoubthi wa-l-khabâ’ith.

group.title: After leaving the toilet

doua.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
doua.translation: « I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#7), Abu Dawud (#30), Ibn Majah (#300), and an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#79). Also see the takhrij of Zad al-Ma'ad (2/386).
doua.phonetic: Ghoufrânak.

group.title: When starting ablution (wudu)

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#101), Ibn Majah (#399) and Ahmad (2/418). Also see Irwa' al-Ghalil (1/122).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi.

group.title: Upon completing ablution (Wudu)

doua.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
doua.translation: « I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muḥammad is His slave and Messenger. »
doua.phonetic: Ash-hadou an lâ ilâha illa l-lâhou, wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, wa ash-hadou anna mou<u>h</u>ammadan 'abdouhou wa rasoûlouhou.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#55, 1/78). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (1/18).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma j'alnî mina t-tawwâbîna wa j'alnî mina-l-mouta<u>t</u>ahhirîn.

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيكَ
doua.translation: « How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You. »
doua.reference: an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#81, p.173). Also see Irwa' al-Ghalil (3/94).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânaka l-lâhoumma wa bi-<u>h</u>amdika. Ash-hadou an lâ ilâha illâ anta, astaghfirouka wa atûbou ilayka.

group.title: When leaving home
group.version: En sortant de la maison

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ، وَلاَحَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5094, 4/325) and at-Tirmidhi (#3427, 5/490). Voir Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/151).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi, tawakkaltou 'alâ l-lâhi, wa lâ <u>h</u>awla wa lâ qouwwata illâ billâhi.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَعْوْذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضِلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أُوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5094), at-Tirmidhi (#3427), an-Nasai (8/268) and Ibn Majah (#3884). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/152) and Sahih Ibn Majah (2/336).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika an a<u>d</u>illa aw u<u>d</u>alla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw a<u>z</u>lima, aw u<u>z</u>lama, aw ajhala, aw youjhala 'alayya.

group.title: Upon entering home
group.version: Coming home

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللهِ رَبَّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5096, 4/325) and Muslim (#2018).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi walajnâ, wa Bismillâhi kharajnâ, wa 'alâ l-lâhi tawakkalnâ.

group.title: When going to the Masjid
group.version: When we go to the mosque

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُوْراً، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُوْراً، وَ فِي سَمْعِي نُوْراً، وَ فِي بَصَري نُوْراً، وَ مِنْ فَوقِي نُوْراً، وَمِنْ تحْتِي نُوْراً، وَعَنْ يَمِيْنِي نُوْراً، وَ عَنْ شِمَالِي نُوْراً، وَ مِنْ أَمَامِي نُوْراً، وَ مِنْ خَلْفِي نُوراً، واجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُوراً، وَ أعْظِمْ لي نُوراً، وَ عَظِّمْ لي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ لي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُوراً، اللهم أَعْطِنِي نُوراً، وَاجْعَلْ في عَصَبِي نُوراً، وَ في لَحْمِي نُوراً، وَ في دَمِي نُوراً، وَ في شَعْرِي نُوراً، وَ في بَشَرِي نُوراً [1] . [اللهم اجْعَلْ لي نُوراً في قَبْرِي...وَ نُوراً في عِظَامِي] [2] [وَ زِدْنِي نُوراً، وَ زِدْنِي نُوراً، وَ زِدْنِي نُوراً] [1] [وَهَبْ لِي نُوراً عَلَى نُورٍ] [2] .
doua.translation: « O Allah, place within my heart light, and upon my tongue light, and within my ears light, and within my eyes light, and place behind me light and in front of me light and above me light and beneath me light. O Allah, bestow upon me light. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma j'al fî qalbî nûran, wa fî lisânî nûran, wa fî sam'î nûran, wa fî ba<u>s</u>arî nûran, wa min fawqî nûran, wa min ta<u>h</u>tî nûran, wa 'an yamînî nûran, wa 'an shimâlî nûran, wa min amâmî nûran, wa min khalfî nûran. Wa j'al fî nafsî nûran, wa a'<u>z</u>im lî nûran, wa 'a<u>z</u><u>z</u>im lî nûran. Wa j'al lî nûran, wa j'alnî nûran. Allâhoumma a'<u>t</u>inî nûran, wa j'al fî 'a<u>s</u>abî nûran, wa fî la<u>h</u>mî nûran, wa fî damî nûran, wa fî sha'rî nûran, wa fî basharî nûran. Allâhoumma j'al lî nûran fî qabrî, wa nûran fî 'i<u>z</u>âmî. Wa zidnî nûran, wa zidnî nûran, wa zidnî nûran. Wa hab lî nûran 'alâ nûr.

group.title: Upon entering the Masjid
group.version: At the entrance of the mosque

doua.arabic: (يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ اليُمْنَى) [1] ، ويقول : (أَعُوْذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ) [2] ، (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلاةُ) [3] . [وَالسَّلامُ عَلَى رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ] [4] ، (اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ) [5] .
doua.translation: « (Enter with your right foot [1] and say:) « I take refuge with Allah, the Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. [2] In the name of Allah, and prayers [3] and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. [4] O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me. » [5]
doua.reference: [1] Al-Hakim (1/218) and authenticated it with the conditions of Muslim and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him, al-Bayhaqi (2/442), and al-Albani declared it hassan in Silsilah al-Ahadith as-Sahihah (#2478, 5/624). [2] Abu Dawud (#466). Also see Sahih al-Jami' (#4591). [3] An-Nisa i (#88) and al-Albani declared it hassan. [4] Abu Dawud (#465, 1/126). Also see Sahih al-Jami' (#514, 1/528). [5] Muslim (#713, 1/494), and Ibn Majah (#771).
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou billâhi-l-'a<u>z</u>îmi, wa bi-wajhihi-l-karîmi, wa soultânihi-l-qadîmi, mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni r-râjim. [Bismillâhi, wa <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>alâtou wa s-salâmou 'alâ rasoûli l-lâhi]. Allâhoumma fta<u>h</u> lî abwâba ra<u>h</u>matik.

group.title: Upon leaving the Masjid
group.version: At the exit of the mosque

doua.arabic: (يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُسْرَى) [1] وَ يَقُولُ : (بِسْمِ اللهِ وَ الصَّلاةُ وَالسَّلامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ، اللهم إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اللهم اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ) [2] .
doua.translation: « (Exit with your left foot and say:) [1] « In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favor. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil. » [2]
doua.reference: [1] Al-Hakim (1/218), al-Bayhaqi (2/442) and al-Albani declared it hassan in Silsilah al-Ahadith as-Sahihah (#2478, 5/624). [2] Voir takhrij of the previous hadith (dou'a #20) and the extension (اللهم اعصمني من الشيطان الرجيم) is from Ibn Majah (#773), voir Sahih Ibn Majah (1/129).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi, wa <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>alâtou wa s-salâmou 'alâ rasoûli l-lâhi. Allâhoumma innî as alouka min fa<u>d</u>lika. Allâhoumma '<u>s</u>imnî mina sh-shay<u>t</u>ani r-rajîm.

group.title: When we hear the call to prayer, after the adhan and before the iqama

doua.arabic: يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ المُؤَذِّنُ إلَّا فِي «حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلاةِ» وَ «حَيَّ عَلَى الفَلاحِ» فَيَقُولُ : «لَا حَولَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إلَّا بِاللهِ».
doua.translation: One repeats just as the muadhdhin (one who calls to prayers) says, except when he says « come to prayer » or « come to success, » one should say « There is no might nor power except with Allah. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#611, 1/152) and Muslim (#383, 1/288).
doua.phonetic: Lâ <u>h</u>awla wa lâ qouwwata illâ billâhi.

doua.arabic: يَقُولُ : «وَ أَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إله إلَّا اللهُ وَ حْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ، رَضِيْتُ بِاللهِ رَبًّا، وَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا، وَ بِالإِسْلامِ دِيْنًا» [1] «يَقُولَ ذَلِكَ عَقِبَ تَشَهُّدِ المُؤَذِّنِ». [2]
doua.translation: Say: « And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muḥammad is His slave and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muḥammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion. » [1] Say this after the declaration of faith called by the muadhdhin. [2] »
doua.phonetic: >Wa anâ ash-hadou an lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lâhou, wa anna mou<u>h</u>ammadan 'abdouhou wa rasoûlouhou. Ra<u>d</u>îtou billâhi rabban, wa bi-mou<u>h</u>ammadin rasoûlan, wa bi-l-islâmi dînan.

doua.arabic: يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِي صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ فَرَاغِهِ مِنْ إِجَابَةِ المُؤَذِّنِ.
doua.translation: One should send prayers on the Prophet ﷺ after answering the call of the muadhdhin.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma <u>s</u>alli 'alâ sayyidinâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ âlihi wa <u>s</u>a<u>h</u>bihi wa sallim.

doua.arabic: يَقُولُ : «اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ ، وَالصَّلاةِ القَائِمَةِ ، آتِ مُحَمَّداً الوَسِيْلَةَ وَالفَضِيْلَةَ ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَاماً مَحْمُوْداً الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ ، [إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادِ]».
doua.translation: « Say: « O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muḥammad al-Wasilah and al-Fadilah and send him upon a praised platform which You have promised him. (Verily, You never fail in Your promise.) » »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#614, 1/152) and what is between the brackets is from al-Bayhaqi (1/410). Shaykh 'Abd al-'Aziz bin Baz authenticated the chain of the latter in touhfah al-Akhbar (p.38).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma rabba hâdhihi d-da'wati t-âmmati, wa <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>alâti-l-qâ imati.Âti mou<u>h</u>ammadan al wasîlata wa-l-fa<u>d</u>îlata, wa b'ath-hou maqâman ma<u>h</u>mûdan al-ladhî wa'adtahou. [Innaka lâ toukhlifou-l-mî'âd.]

doua.arabic: يَدْعُو لِنَفْسِهِ بَيْنَ الأَذَانِ وَالإِقَامَةِ؛ فَإنَّ الدُّعَاءَ حِيْنَئذٍ لَا يُرَدُّ.
doua.translation: One should also supplicate for himself during the time between the adhan and the iqamah as supplication at such time is not rejected.
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#212), Abu Dawud (#521), and Ahmad (3/119). Also see Irwa' al-Ghalil (1/262).

group.title: When we start prayer
group.version: At the start of the salat

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ، كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ، بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْمَاءِ وَالْبَرَدِ.
doua.translation: « O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced the East from the West. O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth. O Allah cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#744, 1/181) and Muslim (#598, 1/419).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ba'id baynî wa bayna kha<u>t</u>âyâya kamâ bâ'adta bayna-l-mashriqi wa-l-maghribi. Allâhoumma naqqinî min kha<u>t</u>âyâya kamâ younaqqa th-thawbou-l-abya<u>d</u>ou mina d-danasi. Allâhoumma ghsilnî min kha<u>t</u>âyâya bi th-thalji wa-l-mâ i wa-l-barad.

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.
doua.translation: « How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshiped except You. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud [775,776], at-Tirmidhi [242, 432], an-Nasai (2/133), and Ibn Majah [804, 806]. Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (1/77) and Sahih Ibn Majah (1/135).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânaka l-lâhoumma wa bi-<u>h</u>amdika, wa tabâraka smouka wa ta'âla jaddouka, wa lâ ilâha ghayrouka.

doua.arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفاً وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلاتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ, وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي، وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي، وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعاً إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَاهْدِنِي لأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاقِ لا يَهْدِي لأَحْسَنِهَا إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَدَيْكَ، وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوْبُ إِلَيْكَ.
doua.translation: « I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the earth and I am not of those who associate (others with Allah). Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my life, and my death are for Allah, Lord of the Worlds, no partner has He, with this I am commanded and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliever me from it other than You. Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve You. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by Your will and will return to You. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You. »
doua.phonetic: Wajjahtou wajhiya li-l-ladhî fa<u>t</u>ara s-samâwâti wa-l-ar<u>d</u>a, <u>h</u>anîfan wa mâ anâ mina-l-moushrikîna. Inna <u>s</u>alâti wa nouSoukî, wa ma<u>h</u>yâya wa mamâtî li-l-lâhi rabbi-l-'âlamîna, lâ sharîka lahou. Wa bi-dhâlika umirtou wa anâ mina-l-Muslimîna. Allâhoumma anta-l-malikou lâ ilâha illâ anta. Anta rabbî wa anâ 'abdouka, <u>z</u>alamtou nafsî wa 'taraftou bi-dhanbî. Fa-ghfir lî dhounûbî jamî'an, innahou lâ yaghfirou dh-dhounûba illâ anta. Wa hdinî li-a<u>h</u>sani-l-akhlâqi, lâ yahdî li-a<u>h</u>sanihâ illâ anta. Wa <u>s</u>rif 'annî sayyi ahâ, lâ ya<u>s</u>rifou 'annî sayy ahâ illâ anta. Labbayka wa sa'dayka, wa-l-khayrou koullouhou bi-yadayka, wa sh-sharrou laysa ilayka, anâ bika wa ilayka, tabârakta wa ta'âlayta, astaghfirouka wa atûbou ilayk.

doua.arabic: اللهم رَبَّ جِبرَائِيْلَ، وَ مِيكَائيْلَ، وَإسْرَافيْلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَ الأرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ، أنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ، اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الحَقِّ بِإذْنِكَ، إنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ.
doua.translation: « O Allah, Lord of Jibraʾil, Mikaʾil, and Israfil (Great angels), Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma, rabba Jibrâ îla, wa Mîkâ îla, wa Isrâfîla ! Fâtira s-samâwâti wa-l-ar<u>d</u>i, 'âlima l-ghaybi wa sh-shahâdati, anta ta<u>h</u>koumou bayna 'ibâdika fîmâ kânû fîhi yakhtalifoûna. Ihdinî li-mâ khtoulifa fîhi mina-l-<u>h</u>aqqi bi-idhnika. Innaka tahdî man tashâ u ilâ <u>s</u>irâ<u>t</u>în moustaqîm.

doua.arabic: اللهُ أكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، اللهُ أكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، اللهُ أكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَ الحَمْدُلِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، وَالحَمْدُلِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، وَالحَمْدُلِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، وَ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بُكْرَةً وَأصِيلاً (ثَلاثًا) أعُوذ بِا اللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ : مِنْ نَفْحِهِ وَ نَفْثِهِ، وَ هَمْزِهِ.
doua.translation: « Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, much praise is for Allah, much praise is for Allah, much praise is for Allah, and I declare the perfection of Allah in the early morning and in the late afternoon. (3 times) I take refuge with Allah from the devil, from his pride, his poetry and his madness. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#764, 1/203), Ibn Majah (#807, 1/265), Ahmad (#4/85), and Muslim (#601, 1/420) with extension.
doua.phonetic: Allâhou akbarou kabîran. Allâhou akbarou kabîran. Allâhou akbarou kabîran. Wa-l-<u>h</u>amdou li-l-âhi kathîran. Wa-l-<u>h</u>amdou li-l-âhi kathîran. Wa-l-<u>h</u>amdou li-l-âhi kathîran. Wa Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi boukratan wa a<u>s</u>îlan. (3 times), A'oûdhou billâhi mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni min nafkhihi, wa naftihi, wa hamzihi.

doua.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ وَ مَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَ لَكَ الحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ وَ مَنْ فِيهِنَّ، [وَ لَكَ الحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ وَ مَنْ فِيهِنَّ]، [وَ لَكَ الحَمْدُ، لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ وَ مَنْ فِيهِنَّ][وَ لَكَ الحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ][وَ لَكَ الحَمْدُ][أَنْتَ الحَقُّ، وَ وَعْدُكَ الحَقُّ، وَ قَولُكَ الحَقُّ، وَ لِقَاؤُكَ الحَقُّ، وَالجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ حَقٌّ، وَالسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ][اللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ أسْلَمْتُ، وَ عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَ بِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَ إلَيْكَ أنَبْتُ، وَ بِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَ إلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ. فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، و أخَّرْتُ، وَ مَا أسْرَرْتُ، وَ مَا أعْلَنْتُ][أَنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وَ أَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ لَا إلٰهَ إلَّا أَنْتَ][أَنْتَ إلٰهِي لَا إلٰهَ إلَّا أَنْتَ].
doua.translation: The Prophet saws would say (as an opening supplication in prayer) when arising from sleep to perform prayers during the night: « O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise. You are Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise and the kingdom of the heavens and the Earth and all that is within them. To You belongs all praise, You are the King of the heavens and the Earth and to You belongs all praise. You are The Truth, Your promise is true, Your Word is true, and the Day in which we will encounter You is true, the Garden of Paradise is true and the Fire is true, and the Prophets are true, Muḥammad () is true and the Final Hour is true. O Allah, unto You I have submitted, and upon You I have relied, and in You I have believed, and to You I have turned in repentance, and over You I have disputed, and to You I have turned for judgment. So forgive me for what has come to pass of my sins and what will come to pass, and what I have hidden and what I have made public. You are al-Muqaddim and al-Muʾakhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You, You are my Deity, none has the right to be worshipped except You. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (3/3), (11/116), and (#1120, 13/371, 423, 465), and Muslim (#769, 1/532) in a shortened version.
doua.phonetic:
Allâhoumma laka-l-hamdou anta nûrou s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi wa man fîhinn. Wa laka-l-hamdou. Anta qayyimou s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi wa man fîhinn, [Wa laka-l-hamdou. Anta rabbou s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi wa man fîhinna.] [Wa laka-l-hamdou. Laka moulkou s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi wa man fîhinn.] [Wa laka-l-hamdou. Anta malikou s-samâwâti wa-l-ardi.] [Wa laka-l-hamdou.] [Anta-l-haqqou, wa wa'douka-l-haqqou, wa qawlouka-l-haqqou, wa liqâ uka-l-haqqou, wa-l-jannatou haqqoun, wa n-nârou haqqoun, wa n-nabiyyûna haqqoun, wa mouhammadoun haqqoun, wa s-sâ'atou haqqoun.] [Allâhoumma laka aslamtou, wa 'alayka tawwakaltou, wa bika âmantou, wa ilayka anabtou, wa bika khâsamtou, wa ilayka hâkamtou.
Fa-ghfir lî mâ qaddamatou, wa mâ akhkhartou, wa mâ asrartou, wa mâ a'lantou.]
[Anta-l-mouqaddimou wa anta-l-mou akhkhirou. Lâ ilâha illâ anta.] [Anta ilâhî lâ ilâha illâ anta.]

group.title: While bowing in salah (ruku')
group.version: During the ruku' in the salat

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبَّيَ الْعَظِيمِ (ثلاثا)
doua.translation: « How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme. (3 times) »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#871), at-Tirmidhi (#262), An-Nisa i (1/190), Ibn Majah (#888), et Ahmad (#394, 5/382,394). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (1/83).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>âna rabbiya-l-'a<u>z</u>îm

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْلِي
doua.translation: « How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#794, 1/99) and Muslim (#484, 1/350).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânaka l-lâhoumma rabbanâ wa bi-<u>h</u>amdika. Allâhoumma ghfir lî.

doua.arabic: سُبُّوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ.
doua.translation: « Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angels and the Ruḥ (Jibraʾil).) »
doua.reference: Muslim (#487, 1/353) and Abu Dawud (#872, 1/230).
doua.phonetic: Soubbû<u>h</u>un, qouddousoun, rabbou-l-malâ ikati wa r-roû<u>h</u>.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي ، وَبَصَرِي ، وَمُخِّي ، وَعَظْمِي ، وَعَصَبِي ، [وَمَا اسْتَقَلَّت بِهِ قَدَمِي]
doua.translation: « O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, sight, mind, bones, tendons and what my feand carry are humbled before You. »
doua.reference: Muslim (#771, 1/534), Abu Dawud (#760), at-Tirmidhi (#266) and an-Nasai (2/130). L'extension est in le Sahih de Ibn Hibban (#1901) and Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah (#607).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma laka raka'tou, wa bika âmantou, wa laka aslamtou. Khasha'a laka sam'î, wa ba<u>s</u>arî, wa moukhkhî, wa 'a<u>z</u>mî, wa 'a<u>s</u>sabî wa mâ staqalla bihi qadamî.

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَروتِ ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ ، وَالكِبْرِيَاءِ ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ.
doua.translation: « How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#873, 1/230), an-Nasai (2/191), and Ahmad (6/24).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>âna dhî-l-jabaroûti, wa-l-malakûti, wa-l-kibriyâ i, wa-l-'a<u>z</u>amati

group.title: Upon rising from ruku'

doua.arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ.
doua.translation: « May Allah answer he who praises Him. »
doua.reference: Fath al-Bari (#795, 2/282).
doua.phonetic: Sami'a l-lâhou liman <u>h</u>amidah.

doua.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ.
doua.translation: « Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise. »
doua.reference: Fath al-Bari (#799, 2/284).
doua.phonetic: Rabbanâ wa laka-l-<u>h</u>amdou, <u>h</u>amdan kathîran, <u>t</u>ayyiban, moubârakan fîhi.

doua.arabic: مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ ، أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ ، وَلَامُعْطِي لِمَا مَنَعْتَ ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ.
doua.translation: « The heavens and the earth and all between them abound with Your praises, and all that You will abounds with Your praises. O Possessor of praise and majesty, the truest thing a slave has said (of You) and we are all Your slaves. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty. »
doua.phonetic: Mil a s-samâwâti wa mil a-l-ar<u>d</u>i wa mâ baynahoumâ, wa mil a mâ shi ta min shay in ba'dou. Ahlou th-thanâ i wa-l-majdi. A<u>h</u>aqqou mâ qâla-l-'abdou, wa koullounâ laka 'abdoun. Allâhoumma lâ mâni'a li-mâ a'<u>t</u>yta, wa lâ mou'<u>t</u>iya limâ mana'ta, wa lâ yanfa'ou dhâ-l-jaddi minka-m-jadd.

group.title: During prostration in prayer
group.version: When you make soujoud in salat

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبَّيَ الأَعْلَى (ثلاثا)
doua.translation: « How Perfect my Lord is, The Most High. (3 times) »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#871), at-Tirmidhi (#262), an-Nasai (1/190), Ibn Majah (#888), and Ahmad (#394, 5/382). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (1/83).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>âna rabbiya-l-a'lâ.

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
doua.translation: « How Perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#794, 1/99) and Muslim (#484, 1/350).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânaka l-lâhoumma rabbanâ wa bi-<u>h</u>amdika. Allâhoumma ghfir lî.

doua.arabic: سُبُّوحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ.
doua.translation: « Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angels and the Ruḥ (Jibraʾil). »
doua.reference: Muslim (1/533)
doua.phonetic: Soubbû<u>h</u>un, qouddousoun, rabbou-l-malâ ikati wa r-roû<u>h</u>.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهَ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الخَالِقِينَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed, and unto You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before He Who created it and fashioned it, and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma laka sajadtou, wa bika âmantou, wa laka aslamtou. Sajada wajhî li-l-ladhî khalaqahou wa <u>s</u>awwarahou wa shaqqa sam'ahou wa ba<u>s</u>arahou. Tabâraka l-lâhou a<u>h</u>sanou-l-khâliqîn.

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ
doua.translation: « How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#873, 1/230), Ahmad (6/24), and an-Nasai (2/191). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (1/166).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>âna dhî-l-jabaroûti, wa-l-malakûti, wa-l-kibriyâ i, wa-l-'a<u>z</u>amah.

doua.arabic: اللًّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them, the first and last of them, and the apparent and hidden of them. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir lî dhanbî koullahou, diqqahou wa jillahou, wa awwalahou wa âkhirahou, wa 'alâniyyatahou wa sirrah.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bi-ridâka min sakha<u>t</u>ika, wa bi-mou'âfâtika min 'ouqûbatika. Wa a'oûdhou bika minka. Lâ u<u>h</u><u>s</u>î thanâ an 'alayka, anta kamâ athnayta 'alâ nafsik.

group.title: Between the 2 prostrations (sajdatayn)

doua.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
doua.translation: « My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#874, 1/231). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (1/148).
doua.phonetic: Rabbi ghfir lî. Rabbi ghfir lî.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
doua.translation: « O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, enrich me, give me health, grant me sustenance and raise my rank. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#850), at-Tirmidhi (#284), Ibn Majah (#898). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (1/90), and Sahih Ibn Majah (1/148).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir lî, wa r<u>h</u>amnî, wa hdinî, wa jbournî, wa 'âfinî, wa rzuqnî, wa rfa'nî.

group.title: When there is a verse of prostration
group.version: During the sujud following a verse of prostration

doua.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ (فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ)
doua.translation: « My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing by His might and power. (So Blessed is Allah, the best of creators). »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#580, 2/474), Ahmad (6/30) and al-Hakim declared it sahih and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him (1/220). The extension is from Sourate al-mouʾminun.
doua.phonetic: Sajada wajhî li-l-ladhî khalaqahou wa <u>s</u>awwarahou wa shaqqa sam'ahou wa ba<u>s</u>arahou bi-<u>h</u>awlihi wa qouwwatihi, fa tabâraka l-lâhou a<u>h</u>sanou-l-khâliqîn.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْراً، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْراً، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْراً، وَتَقَبَّلَهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, record for me a reward for this (prostration), and remove from me a sin. Save it for me and accept it from me just as You had accepted it from Your servant Dawud. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#579, 2/473) and al-Hakim declared it Sahih and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him (1/219).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ktoub lî bihâ 'indaka ajran, wa <u>d</u>a' 'annî bihâ wizran, wa j'alhâ lî 'indaka dhoukhran, wa taqabbalhâ minnî kamâ taqabbaltahâ min 'abdika Dâwûd.

group.title: Tashahhud

doua.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَوَاتُ، وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللهِ الصَّالِحِينَ،. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
doua.translation: « Salutations are for Allah. All acts of worship and good deeds are for Him. Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you O Prophet. Peace be upon us and all of Allah's righteous servants. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and I bear witness that Muḥammad is His slave and Messenger. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#831, 2/311) and Muslim (#402, 1/301).
doua.phonetic: At-ta<u>h</u>iyyâtou li-l-lâhi, wa <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>alawâtou wa <u>t</u>-<u>t</u>ayyibâtou. As-salâmou 'alayka ayyouhâ n-nabiyyou wa ra<u>h</u>matou l-lâhi wa barakâtouhou. As-salâmou 'alaynâ wa 'alâ 'ibâdi l-lâhi <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>âli<u>h</u>îna. Ash-hadou an lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa ash-hadou anna mou<u>h</u>ammadan 'abdouhou wa rasoûlouhou.

group.title: Prayer for the Prophet ﷺ after Tashahhud

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
doua.translation: « O Allah, send prayers upon Muḥammad and the followers of Muḥammad, just as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the followers of Ibrahim. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty. O Allah, send blessings upon Muḥammad and upon the family of Muḥammad, just as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma <u>s</u>alli 'alâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ âli mou<u>h</u>ammadin kamâ <u>s</u>allayta 'alâ Ibrâhîma wa 'alâ âli Ibrâhîma. Innaka <u>h</u>amîdoun, majîd. Allâhoumma bârik 'alâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ âli mou<u>h</u>ammadin kamâ bârakta 'alâ Ibrâhîma wa 'alâ âli Ibrâhîma. Innaka <u>h</u>amîdoun, majîd.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
doua.translation: « O Allah, send prayers upon Muḥammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muḥammad, just as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim, and send blessings upon Muḥammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muḥammad, just as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#3369, 2/407) and Muslim (#407, 1/306).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma <u>s</u>alli 'alâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ azwâjihi wa dhourriyyâtihi kamâ <u>s</u>allayta 'alâ âli Ibrâhîm. Wa bârik 'alâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ azwâjihi wa dhourriyyâtihi kamâ bârakta 'alâ âli Ibrâhîm. Innaka <u>h</u>amîdoun majîd.

group.title: Between the last tashahhud and the final salam

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the torment of the Fire, from the trials and tribulations of life and death, and from the evil affliction of al-Masiḥ al-Dajjal. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (2/102) and Muslim (1/412).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika min 'adhâbi-l-qabri, wa min 'adhâbi jahannama, wa min fitnati-l-ma<u>h</u>yâ wa-l-mamâti, wa min sharri fitnati-l-masîhi d-dajjâl.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I take refuge in You from the temptation and trial of al-Masiḥ al-Dajjal, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of life and death. O Allah, I take refuge in You from sin and debt. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#832, 2/102) and Muslim (#589, 1/412). Cette version est de Muslim.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika min 'adhâbi-l-qabri, wa a'oûdhou bika min fitnati-l-masîhi d-dajjâl, wa a'oûdhou bika min fitnati-l-ma<u>h</u>yâ wa-l-mamâti. Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika mina-l-ma thami wa-l-maghrami.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْماً كَثِيراً، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْني، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively and none can forgive sin except You, so forgive me a forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy upon me. Surely, You are The Most-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî <u>z</u>alamtou nafsî <u>z</u>ulman kathîran, wa lâ yaghfirou dh-dhounûba illâ anta. Fa-ghfir lî maghfiratan min 'indika, wa r<u>h</u>amnî, innaka anta-l-ghafoûrou r-ra<u>h</u>îm.

doua.arabic: للَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي، أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass as well as those which shall come to pass, and those I have committed in secrand as well as those I have made public, and where I have exceeded all bounds as well as those things about which You are more knowledgeable. You are al-Muqaddim and al-Muʾakhkhir. None has the right to be worshiped except You. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir lî mâ qaddamatou, wa mâ akhkhartou, wa mâ asrartou, wa mâ a'lantou, wa mâ asraftou, wa mâ anta a'lamou bihi minnî. Anta-l-mouqaddimou wa anta-l-mou akhkhirou. Lâ ilâha illâ anta.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1522, 2/86) and an-Nasai (3/53). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (1/284).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma a'innî 'alâ dhikrika, wa shoukrika, wu <u>h</u>usni 'ibâdatik.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ البُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُبِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأعُوذُبِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge in You from miserliness and cowardice, I take refuge in You lest I be returned to the worst of lives. And I take refuge in You from the trails and tribulations of this life and the punishment of the grave. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika min al boukhli, wa a'oûdhou bika min al joubni, wa a'oûdhou bika min an ouradda ilâ ardhali-l-'oumour. Wa a'oûdhou bika min fitnati d-dounyâ wa 'adhâbi-l-qabri.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ النَّارِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#792) and Ibn Majah, voir Sahih Ibn Majah (2/328).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka-l-jannata wa a'oûdhou bika mina n-nar.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الْغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ؛ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيماً لاَ يَنْفَدُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرَّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقَائِكَ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، وَلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيَّنَّا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know such life to be good for me and take me if You know death to be better for me. O Allah, make me fearful of You whether in secrand or in public and I ask You to make me true in speech, in times of pleasure and anger. I ask you to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty and I ask You for everlasting bliss and joy which will never cease. I ask You to make me pleased with what You have decreed and for an easy life after death. I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to encounter You in a manner which does not entail a calamity which will bring about harm nr a trial which will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us of those who guide and are rightly guided. »
doua.reference: an-Nasai (#55, 4/54) and Ahmad (4/364). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih an-Nasai (1/281).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma, bi-'ilmika-l-ghayba wa qoudratika 'alâ-l-khalqi, a<u>h</u>yinî mâ 'alimta-l-<u>h</u>ayâta khayran lî, wa tawwafanî idhâ 'alimta-l-wafâta khayran lî. Allâhoumma innî as alouka khashyataka fî-l-ghaybi wa sh-shahâdati. Wa as alouka kalimata-l-haqqi fî r-ri<u>d</u>â wa-l-gha<u>d</u>abi. Wa as alouka-l-qa<u>s</u>da fî-l-ghinâ wa-l-faqri. Wa as alouka na'îman lâ yanfadou wa as alouka qourrata 'aynin lâ tanqa<u>t</u>i'ou. Wa as alouka r-ri<u>d</u>â ba'da-l-qa<u>d</u>â, wa as alouka barda-l-'ayshi ba'da-l-mawti. Wa as alouka ladhdhata n-na<u>z</u>ari ilâ wajhika wa sh-shawqa ilâ liqâ ika fî ghayri <u>d</u>arrâ a mou<u>d</u>irratin wa lâ fitnatin mou<u>d</u>illatin. Allâhoumma zayyinnâ bi-zînati-l-îmâni, wa j'alnâ houdâtan mouhtadîn.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ، الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You O Allah—as You are The One, The Only, al-samad, The One who begets not, nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him—that You forgive me my sins for verily You are The Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful. »
doua.reference: an-Nasai (3/52) and Ahmad (4/238). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih an-Nasai (1/280).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka, yâ Allâhou, bi-annaka-l-wâ<u>h</u>idou-l-a<u>h</u>adou <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>amadou, al-ladhî lam yalid wa lam yûlad, wa lam yakoun lahou koufouan a<u>h</u>adoun, an taghfira lî dhounûbî. Innaka anta-l-ghafoûrou r-ra<u>h</u>îm.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، الْمَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيْعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، يَاذَا الْجَلالِ وَالإكْرَامِ، يَاحَيُّ يَاقَيُّومُ، إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshiped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O possessor of majesty and honor, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, verily I ask You for Paradise and I take refuge with You from the Fire. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1495), an-Nasai (3/52), Ibn Majah (#3858) and at-Tirmidhi (#3544). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/329).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka bi-anna laka-l-<u>h</u>amd, lâ ilâha illâ anta wa<u>h</u>daka lâ sharîka laka, al mannânou. Yâ badî'ou s-samâwâti wa-l-ar<u>d</u>i ! Yâ dhâ-l-jalâli wa-l-ikrâmi. Yâ <u>h</u>ayyou, yâ qayyûmou ! Innî as alouka-l-jannata wa a'oûdhou bika mina n-nâr.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshiped except You, The One, al-samad Who begets not nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1493, 2/62), at-Tirmidhi (#3475, 5/515), Ibn Majah (#3857, 2/1267) and Ahmad (5/360). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/329) and Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/163).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka bi-annî ash-hadou annaka anta l-lâhou lâ ilâha ukkâ anta-l-a<u>h</u>adou <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>amadou, al-ladhî lam yalid wa lam yûlad, wa lam yakoun lahou koufouan a<u>h</u>ad.

group.title: After the final salam, the dhikr after the prayer

doua.arabic: (١) أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثلاثا) (٢) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَاذَا الجَلالِ وَالإكْرَامِ
doua.translation: « (1) I ask Allah for forgiveness. (3 times) (2) O Allah, You are al-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor. »
doua.phonetic: Astaghfirou l-lâha (3 times). Allâhoumma anta s-salâmou wa minka s-salâmou, tabârakta yâ dhâ-l-jalâli wa-l-ikrâm.

doua.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#844, 1/255) and Muslim (#593, 1/414).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-<u>h</u>amdou wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîr. Allâhoumma lâ mâni'a limâ a'<u>t</u>ayta wa lâ mou'<u>t</u>iya limâ mana'ta wa lâ yanfa'ou dhâ-l-jaddi minka-l-jadd.

doua.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. There is no might nor power except with Allah, none has the right to be worshiped except Allah and we worship none except Him. For Him is all favor, grace, and glorious praise. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah and we are sincere in faith and devotion to Him although the disbelievers detest it. »
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-<u>h</u>amdou wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîroun. Lâ <u>h</u>awla wa lâ qouwwata illâ billâhi.Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa lâ na'boudou illâ iyyâhou, lahou n-ni'matou wa lahou-l-fa<u>d</u>lou wa lahou th-thanâ u-l-<u>h</u>asanou. Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, moukhli<u>s</u>îna lahou d-dîna wa law kariha-l-kâfiroûn.

doua.arabic:
(١) سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (ثلاثا و ثلاثين)
(٢) لاَ إِلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
doua.translation: « (1) How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest. (33 times) ;(2) None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. »
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi, wa-l-<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi, wa l-lâhou akbar (33 times). Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-<u>h</u>amdou wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîr.

doua.translation: The following 3 surahs should be recited once after Zuhr, ‘Asar and ‘Isha’ prayers and thrice after Fajr and Maghrib: (1) Al-Ikhlas (2) Al-Falaq (3) An-Nas »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1523, 2/86) and an-Nasai (3/68). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (2/8).
doua.phonetic:
Bismillâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
Qoul houwa l-lâhou ahad. Allâhou s-samad, Lam yalid wa lam yûlad, wa lam yakoun lahou koufouan ahad.

Bismillâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
Qoul a'oûdhou bi-rabbi-l-falaq, min sharri mâ khalaq, wa min sharri ghâsiqin idhâ waqab, wa min sharri n-naffâthâti fî-l-'ouqad, wa min sharri hâsidin idhâ hasad.

Bismillâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
Qoul a'oûdhou bi-rabbi n-nâs, maliki n-nâs, ilâhi n-nâs, min sharri-l-waswâsi-l-khannâs, al-ladhî youwaswisou fî soudouri n-nâs, mina-l-jinnati wa n-nâs.

doua.arabic: (اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ...)
doua.translation: It is also from the Sunnah to recite ayah al-Kursi after each prayer: [Surah al-Baqarah, 2:255] »
doua.reference: an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (100) and Ibn Sinni [121]. Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih al Jami' (#6464, 5/339) and Silsilah al-Ahadith as-Sahihah (#972, 2/697).
doua.phonetic: Allâhou lâ ilâha illâ houwa-l-<u>h</u>ayyou-l-qayyûm. Lâ ta khoudhouhou sinatoun wa lâ nawm, lahou mâ fî s-samâwâti wa mâ fî-l-ar<u>d</u>. Man dhâ l-ladhî yashfa'ou 'indahou illâ bi-idhnihi. Ya'lamou mâ bayna aydîhim wa mâ khalfahoum. Wa lâ you<u>h</u>î<u>t</u>ûna bi-shay in min 'ilmihi illâ bi-mâ shâ a. Wasi'a koursiyyouhou s-samâwâti wa-l-ar<u>d</u>. Wa lâ ya ûdouhou <u>h</u>if<u>z</u>uhoumâ, wa houwa-l-'aliyyou-l-'a<u>z</u>îm.

doua.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ (عشر مرات بعد المغرب و الصبح)
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, He gives life and causes death and He is over all things omnipotent. (10 times after the Maghrib and Fajr prayers)
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3474, 5/515) and Ahmad (4/227). Also see Zad al-Ma'ad (1/300).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-<u>h</u>amdou, you<u>h</u>yî wa youmîtou wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîr.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً (بعد السلام من صلاة الفجر)
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable (To be said after giving salam for the Fajr prayer).
doua.reference: Ibn Majah (#925). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (1/152) and Majmou' az-Zawaid (#95, 10/111).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka 'ilman nâfi'an, wa rizqan <u>t</u>ayyiban, wa 'amalan moutaqabbalan.

group.title: Al-Istikhara, the prayer of consultation
group.version: To make a decision or make a choice

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيْرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنْ هَذَاالأَمْرَ - ويُسَمِّي حَاجَتَه - خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أو قالَ : عَاجِلِهِ وَ آجِلِهِ - فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي، ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أوْ قالَ : عَاجِلِهِ وَ آجِلِهِ - فَاصْرِفْهُ عَني، وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ. وَ مَا نَدِمَ مَنْ اسْتَخَارَ الخَالِقَ، وَ شَاوَرَ المَخْلُوقِينَ المُؤمِنِينَ، وَ تَثَبَّتَ فِي أمْرِهِ، فَقَدْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَهُ : ﴿وَ شَاوِرْ هُمْ فِي الأَمْرِ فَإذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللهِ﴾ (٢)
doua.translation: On the authority of Jabir ibn 'Abd Allah, who said: « The Prophet saws would instruct us to pray for guidance in all of our concerns, just as he would teach us a chapter from the Qurʾan. He would say ‘if any of you intends to undertake a matter then land him pray 2 rak'ahs of prayer after which he should supplicate : (1) « O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power I seek strength and I ask You from Your immense favor, for verily You are able while I am not and verily You know while I do not and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah if You know this affair- and here he mentions his need- to be good for me in relation to my religion, my life, and end, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me with it, and if You know this affair to be ill for me towards my religion, my life and end, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree from me what is good and wherever it be and make me satisfied with such. »
doua.reference: (1) al-Bukhari (#1162, 7/162). (2) Sourate ali 'Imran, v159.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî astakhîrouka bi-'ilmika wa astaqdirouka bi-qoudratika, wa as-alouka min fa<u>d</u>lika-l-'a<u>z</u>îmi. Fa-innaka taqdirou wa lâ aqdirou, wa ta'lamou wa lâ a'lamou, wa anta 'allâmou-l-ghouyûbi. Allâhoumma in kounta ta'lamou anna hâdhâ-l-amra (qoue l on explicite) khayroun lî fî dînî wa ma'âshî, wa 'âqibati amrî (ou : 'âjilihi wa âjilihi) fa-qdourhou lî, wa yassirhou lî, thoumma bârik lî fîhi. Wa in kounta ta'lamou anna hâdhâ-l-amra (qoue l on explicite) sharroun lî fî dînî wa ma'âshî, , wa 'âqibati amrî (ou : 'âjilihi wa âjilihi) fa-<u>s</u>rifhou 'annî, wa <u>s</u>rifnî 'anhou, wa qdour lî-l-khayra <u>h</u>aythou kâna thoumma ar<u>d</u>dinî bihi.

group.title: On morning (fajr) and evening (maghrib)
group.version: To protect yourself every day, day and night protection dhikr

doua.arabic: ﴿اللهُ لَا إله إلَّا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ لَا...﴾
doua.translation: « Whoever says this (ayat al-Kursi) when he rises in the morning will be protected from jinns until he retires in the evening, and whoever says it when retiring in the evening will be protected from them until he rises in the morning. »
doua.reference: al-Hakim (1/562) and al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih at-Targhib wa at-Tarhib (#655, 1/273) and he assigned it to an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#960) and at-Tabarani in al-Kabir (#541) and said the chain of transmission is good.
doua.phonetic: Allâhou lâ ilâha illâ houwa-l-<u>h</u>ayyou-l-qayyûm. Lâ ta khoudhouhou sinatoun wa lâ nawm, lahou mâ fî s-samâwâti wa mâ fî-l-ar<u>d</u>. Man dhâ l-ladhî yashfa'ou 'indahou illâ bi-idhnihi. Ya'lamou mâ bayna aydîhim wa mâ khalfahoum. Wa lâ you<u>h</u>î<u>t</u>ûna bi-shay in min 'ilmihi illâ bi-mâ shâ a. Wasi'a koursiyyouhou s-samâwâti wa-l-ar<u>d</u>. Wa lâ ya ûdouhou <u>h</u>if<u>z</u>uhoumâ, wa houwa-l-'aliyyou-l-'a<u>z</u>îm.

doua.arabic:
﴿قُل هُوَ اللهُ أحَدٌ...﴾
﴿قُلْ أعُوذُ بِرَبِّ اْلفَلَقِ...﴾
﴿قُلْ أعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ...﴾
[ثلاث مرات]
doua.translation:
« Recite:
1. Surah al-Ikhlas (Qurʾan: 112)
2. Surah al-Falaq (Qurʾan: 113)
3. Surah An-Nas (Qurʾan: 114)
[3 times] »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5082, 4/322) and at-Tirmidhi (#5/567, 3575). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/182).
doua.phonetic: Qoul houwa l-lâhou a<u>h</u>ad, Allâhou <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>amad... Qoul a'oûdhou bi-rabbi-l falaq... Qoul a'oûdhou bi-rabbi n-nâs

doua.arabic: أصْبَحْنَا وَ أصْبَحَ المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَ الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ، وَ لَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أسْألُكَ خَيْرَ مَا في هَذَا اليَوْمِ وَ خَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَ أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا في هَذَا اليَوْمِ وَ شَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الكَسَلِ، وَ سُوءِ الكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ في النَّارِ وَ عَذَابٍ في القَبْرِ. وَ إذَا أمْسَى قَالَ : أمْسَيْنَا وَ أمْسَى المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ. وَ إذَا أمْسَى قَالَ : رَبِّ أسْألُكَ خَيْرَ مَا في هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَ خَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَ أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا في هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَ شَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا.
doua.translation: « We have entered the morning and with it all dominion is Allah's. Praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him is the praise and He is able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this day and of the days that come after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and of the days that come after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and helpless old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Hell-Fire and from the punishment of the grave.' At night, recite instead: 'We have entered the evening and with it all dominion is Allah's...' and: '...My Lord, I ask you for the goodness of this night and of the nights that come after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and of the nights that come after it... »

doua.arabic: اللهم بِكَ أصْبَحْنَا، وَ بِكَ أمْسَيْنَا، وَ بِكَ نَحْيَا، وَ بِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَ إلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ. وَإذَا أمْسَى قَالَ : اللهم بِكَ أمْسَيْنَا، وَ بِكَ أصْبَحْنَا، وَ بِكَ نَحْيَا، وَ بِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَ إلَيْكَ المَصِيْرُ.
doua.translation: « « O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection. » At night, recite instead: « O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return. » »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3391, 5/466). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/142).
doua.phonetic: Allahoumma bika a<u>s</u>bahnâ, wa bika amsaynâ, wa bika na<u>h</u>yâ, wa bika namûtou, wa ilayka n-noushoûr.

doua.arabic: اللهم أنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إلَهَ إلَّا أنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَ أنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَ أنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَ وَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أبُوءُلَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَ أبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لي فَإنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إلَّا أنْتَ.
doua.translation: « O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshiped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You. »
doua.phonetic:
Allâhoumma anta rabbî, lâ ilâha illâ anta.
Khalaqtanî wa anâ 'abdouka, wa anâ 'alâ 'ahdika wa wa'dika mâ stata tou.
A'oûdhou bika min sharri mâ sana tou. Abû u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya wa abû u bi-dhanbî.
Fa-ghfir lî fa-innahou lâ yaghfirou dh-dhounûba illâ ant.

doua.arabic: اللهم إنِّي أصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَ أُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَ مَلَائِكَتِكَ، وَ جَمِيْعَ خَلْقِكَ، أنَّكَ أنْتَ اللهُ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا أنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ، وَ أنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُولُكَ. [أرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ]
doua.translation: « O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshiped except You, alone, without partner and that Muḥammad is Your Servant and Messenger. [4 times] »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5069, 4/317), al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-moufrad (#1201), an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#9) and Ibn al-sounni (#70).
doua.phonetic:
Allâhoumma innî asbahtou ush-hidouka, wa ush-hidou hamalata 'arshika,
wa malâ ikataka, wa jamî'a khalqika, annaka anta l-lâhou, lâ ilâha
illâ anta, wahdaka lâ sharîka laka, wa anna mouhammadan [sallallahou 'alayhi
wa sallama] 'abdouka wa rasoûlouk. (4 times)

doua.arabic:
أللهم مَا أصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ، أوْ بِأحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الحَمْدُ وَ لَكَ الشُّكْرُ. (١)
و إذَا أمْسَى قَالَ : اللهم مَا أمْسَى بِي...
doua.translation: « O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5073, 4/318), an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#7), Ibn al-sounni (#41), Ibn Hibban in mouwarid (#2361).
doua.phonetic:
Allâhoumma mâ asbaha bî min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika,
fa-minka wahdaka lâ sharîka laka. Fa-laka-l-hamdou wa laka sh-shoukr.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصْرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالْفَقْرِ، وأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.[ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ]
doua.translation: « O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You. O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave; none has the right to be worshipped except You. » [3 times]
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5090, 4/324), Ahmad (5/42), an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#22), Ibn al-sounni (#69), and al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-moufrad. Shaykh Ibn Baz authenticated the chain in Touhfah al-Akhyar (p.26). Al-Albani declared it faible. Voir Da'if al-Jami' (#1210).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma 'âfinî fî badanî. Allâhoumma 'âfinî fî sam'î. Allâhoumma 'âfinî fî basarî. Lâ ilâha illâ anta. Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika mina-l-koufri, wa-l-faqri. Wa a'oûdhou bika min 'adhâbi-l-qabri. Lâ ilâha illâ ant. (3 times)

doua.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ [سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ]
doua.translation: « Allah is sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne. » [7 times]
doua.reference: Ibn al-sounni (#71) avec une chaine marfou'a and Abu Dawud (#5081, 4/321) avec une chaine mawqoufa. Also see Zad al-Ma'ad (2/376). Al-Albani declared it faible. Voir Da'if Abi Dawud.
doua.phonetic: Hasbiya l-lâhou lâ ilâha illâ houwa 'alayhi tawakkaltou, wa houwa rabbou-l-'arshi-l-'a<u>z</u>îmi. (7 times)

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أسْأَلُكَ العَفْوَ وَ العَافِيَةَ في الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أسْأَلُكَ العَفْوَ وَ العَافِيَةَ في دِيْنِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأهْلي وَمالي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْني مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِيْنِي وَعَنْ شِمَالي، وَمِنْ فَوْقي ، وَ أعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and sand at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5074), Ibn Majah (#3871). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/332).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoummâ innî as alouka-l-'afwa wa-l-'âfiyata fi d-douniyâ wa-l-âkhirati. Allâhoummâ innî as alouka-l-'afwa wa-l-'âfiyata fî dînî, wa dounyâya, wa ahlî, wa mâlî. Allâhoumma stour 'awrâtî, wa âmin raw'âtî. Allahoumma <u>h</u>fa<u>z</u>nî minm bayna yadayya, wa min khalfî, wa 'an yamînî, wa 'an shimâlî, wa min fawqî. Wa a'oûdhou bi a<u>z</u>amatika an ughtâla min ta<u>h</u>tî.<

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الأرْضِ، رَبَّ كلِّ شَيءٍ وَمَلِيْكَه، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
doua.translation: « O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3392) and Abu Dawud (#5067). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/142).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma 'âlim-alghaybi wa sh-shahâdati, fâtira s-samâwâti wa-l ar<u>d</u>i, rabba koulli shay in wa malîkahou. Ash-hadou anlâ ilâha illâ anta. A'oûdhou bika min sharrin nafsî, wa min sharri sh-shay<u>t</u>âni wa 'hirkihi, wa an aqtarifa 'alâ nafsî soû an ajourrahou ilâ Muslim

doua.arabic: بِسمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيءٌ في الأرْضِ وَلَا في السَّمَاءِ وَهـوَ السَّمِيعُ العَلِيمُ [ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ]
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing. » [3 times]
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5088, #5089, 4/323), at-Tirmidhi (#3388, 5/465), Ibn Majah (#3869), and Ahmad (1/72). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/332). Shaykh Ibn Baz authenticated the chain in Touhfah al-Akhyar (p.39).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi l-ladhî lâ ya<u>d</u>ourroû ma'a smihi shay un fi-l ar<u>d</u>i wa lâ fi s-samâ i, wa houwa s-sami'-ul-'alîm. (3 times)

doua.arabic: رَضِيْتُ بِاللهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالإسْلامِ دِيْناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا [ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ]
doua.translation: « I am pleased with Allah as the Lord, and Islam as the religion and Muḥammad as the Prophet. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (4/337), an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#4), Ibn al-sounni (#68), Abu Dawud (#5072, 4/318), and at-Tirmidhi (#3389, 5/465). Shaykh Ibn Baz declared it hassan in Touhfah al-Akhyar (#39).
doua.phonetic: Ra<u>d</u>îtou billâhi rabban, wa bi-l-islâmi dînan, wa bi mou<u>h</u>ammadin [<u>s</u>allallahou 'alayhi wa sallama] nabiyyan. (3 times)

doua.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيْثُ، أَصْلِحْ لي شَأْني كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
doua.translation: « O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye. »
doua.reference: al-Hakim (1/545); he authenticated it and Adh-Dhahabi agreed with him. Also see Sahih at-Targhib wa at-Tarhib (#654, 1/273).
doua.phonetic: Yâ <u>h</u>ayyû, yâ qayyûmou bi ra<u>h</u>matika astaghîth. A<u>s</u>li<u>h</u> lî sha nî koullahou wa lâ takilnî ilâ nafsî <u>t</u>arfata 'ayn

doua.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَ أَصْبَحَ المُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِيْنَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هـَذَا اليَوْمِ : فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ وَ نُورَهُ، وَ بَرَكَتَهُ،وَ هُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيْهِ وَ شَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ. و إذا أمسى قال : أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى المُلْكُ لِلّهَِ رَبِّ العَالَمِيْنَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هـَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، فَتْحَهَا، وَنَصْرَهـَا، وَنورَهـَا وَبَرَكَتَهَا، وَ هُدَاهـَا، وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيْهَا وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهـَا.
doua.translation: « We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it. » At night, recite instead: « We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it. »
doua.phonetic: A<u>s</u>ba<u>h</u>nâ wa asbaha-l-moulkou li-l-lâhi rabbi-l-'âlamîn. Allahoumma innî as alouka khayra hâdhâ-l-yawmi : fat<u>h</u>ahou, wa nousrahou, wa nûrahou, wa barakatahou, wa houdâhou. Wa a'oûdhou bika min sharri mâ fîhi wa sharri mâ ba'dah.

doua.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإسْلامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الإخْلاصِ، وَعَلَى دِيْنِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أبِيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيْفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ المُشْرِكِيْنَ. وَ إذَا أمسَى قَالَ : أمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإسْلامِ.
doua.translation: « We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muḥammad and the religion of our forefather Ibrahim, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associated others with Allah. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (3/406,407) and Ibn al-sounni in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#34). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#4674, 4/209).
doua.phonetic: A<u>s</u>bahna 'alâ fi<u>t</u>rati-l-islâmi, wa 'alâ kalimati-l-ikhlâ<u>s</u>i, wa 'alâ nabiyyinâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin, wa 'alâ millati abîna Ibrâhîma, hanîfan, Musliman, wa mâ kâna mina-l-moushrikîn.

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ [مِئَةَ مَرَّةٍ]
doua.translation: « How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. » [100 times]
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi wa bi-<u>h</u>amdihi.

doua.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ، وهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ. [عشر مرات] (١) أو [مرة واحدة] (٢) .
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. [10 times](١) or [Once](٢).
doua.reference: (1) an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#24) from the hadith of Abu Ayub al-Ansari. Also see Sahih at-Targhib wa at-Tarhib (#650, 1/272) and Touhfah al-Akhyar (p.55). (2) Abu Dawud (#5077, 4/319), Ibn Majah (#3867) and Ahmad (4/60). Also see Sahih at-Targhib wa at-Tarhib (1/270), Sahih Abi Dawud (3/957), Sahih Ibn Majah (2/331) and Zad Al-Ma'ad (2/377).
doua.phonetic:
Lâ ilâha illa l-lâhou wahdahou lâ sharîka lah, lahou-l-moulkou walahou-l-hamd,
wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîr. (10 times)

doua.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وحْدَهُ لَا شَريْكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ ولَهُ الحَمْدُ، وهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَدِيْرٌ [مئةَ مَرَّةٍ إذا أصْبَحَ]
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. » (100 times the morning)
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illa l-lâhou wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou lahou-l-moulkou walahou-l-<u>h</u>amd(u), wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîr. (100 times)

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ. [ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ إذا أصْبَحَ]
doua.translation: « How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words. » (3 times the morning)
doua.phonetic: Soubhâna l-lâhi wa bi-<u>h</u>amdihi, 'adada khaqihi, wa ri<u>d</u>â nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midâda kalimâtihi. (3 times)

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَ رِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَ عَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً [إذا أصْبَحَ]
