doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable. » (1 times the morning)
doua.reference: Ibn al-sounni as indicated in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#54) and Ibn Majah (#925).
doua.phonetic:
Allahoumma innî as alouka 'ilman nâfi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban,
wa 'amalan moutaqabbalan.

doua.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ [مِئَةَ مَرَّةٍ اليَوْمِ]
doua.translation: « I seek Your forgiveness, Allah, and repent unto You. » (100 times)
doua.phonetic: Astaghfirou l-lâha wa atûbou ilayh(i)

doua.arabic: أَعُوذُبِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ [ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ إذا أمْسَى]
doua.translation: « I take refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil He has created. » [3 times in the evening]
doua.reference: Ahmad (2/290), an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#590), Ibn al-sounni (#68). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/187), Sahih Ibn Majah (2/266) and Touhfah al-Akhyar (p.45)
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou bi-kalimati l-lâhi-t-tââmmâti min sharri mâ khalaq (3 times).

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ [عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ]
doua.translation: « O Allah, send prayers and blessings upon our Prophet Muḥammad. » [10 times]
doua.reference: At-Tabarani to travers 2 chaines dont l'une est bonne. Voir Majm u al-Zawa id (10/120) and Sahih at-Targhib wa at-Tarhib (#656, 1/273).
doua.phonetic: Allahoumma <u>s</u>alli wa sallim 'alâ nabiyyinâ mou<u>h</u>ammad.

group.title: Before sleeping
group.version: At bedtime

doua.arabic:
﴿قُل هُوَ اللهُ أحَدٌ...﴾
﴿قُلْ أعُوذُ بِرَبِّ اْلفَلَقِ...﴾
﴿قُلْ أعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ...﴾
[ثلاث مرات]
doua.translation: When retiring to his bed every night, the Prophet saws would hold his palms together, (dry) spit in them, recite the last 3 chapters of the Qurʾan and then wipe over his entire body as much as possible with his hands, beginning with his head and face and then all parts of the body; he would do this 3 times.
doua.phonetic:
Bismillâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
qoul houwa l-lâhou ahad. Allâhou s-samad, Lam yalid wa lam yûlad, wa lam yakoun lahou koufouan ahad.

Bismillâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
qoul a'oûdhou bi-rabbi-l-falaq, min sharri mâ khalaq, wa min sharri ghâsiqin idhâ waqab, wa min sharri n-naffâthâti fî-l-'ouqad, wa min sharri hâsidin idhâ hasad.

Bismillâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
qoul a'oûdhou bi-rabbi n-nâs, maliki n-nâs, ilâhi n-nâs, min sharri-l-waswâsi-l-khannâs, al-ladhî youwaswisou fî soudouri n-nâs, mina-l-jinnati wa n-nâs.

doua.arabic: ﴿اللهُ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ... ﴾
doua.translation: The Prophet saws also said: « When you are about to sleep, recit ayah al-Kursi, for there will remain over you a protection from Allah and no devil will draw near you until morning. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhou lâ ilâha illâ houwa-l-<u>h</u>ayyou-l-qayyûm. Lâ ta khoudhouhou sinatoun wa lâ nawm, lahou mâ fî s-samâwâti wa mâ fî-l-ar<u>d</u>. Man dhâ l-ladhî yashfa'ou 'indahou illâ bi-idhnihi. Ya'lamou mâ bayna aydîhim wa mâ khalfahoum. Wa lâ you<u>h</u>î<u>t</u>ûna bi-shay in min 'ilmihi illâ bi-mâ shâ a. Wasi'a koursiyyouhou s-samâwâti wa-l-ar<u>d</u>. Wa lâ ya ûdouhou <u>h</u>if<u>z</u>uhoumâ, wa houwa-l-'aliyyou-l-'a<u>z</u>îm.

doua.arabic: ﴿ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ﴿٢٨٥﴾لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ﴾
doua.translation: « The Prophet saws also said: « Whoever recites the last 2 verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night; those 2 verses shall be sufficient for him. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#4008, 9/94) and Muslim (#808, 1/554).
doua.phonetic: amana r-rassulou bima unzila ilayhi mi-rabbihi wa al-mou uminun koulloun amana billahi wa mala ikatihi wa koutoubihi wa rouSoulih, la noufarriqou bayna aĥadin mi-rousSoulih wa qalu sami'na wa a<u>ţa</u>'na ghoufranaka rabbana wa ilayka al-ma</u>ş</u>ir. La youkallifou allahou nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha mak tassabat. Rabbana la tou akhidhna in nassina aw akh<u>t</u>a'na. Rabbana wa la taĥmil 'alayna i<u>s</u>ran kama <u>h</u>amaltahou 'alá l-ladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la touĥammilna ma la <u>t</u>aqata lana bihi wa'fou 'anna waghfir lana war <u>h</u>amna anta mawlana fanşurna 'alá al-qawmi l-lafirin.

doua.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
doua.translation: « If one of you rises from his bed and then returns to it he should dust it with the edge of his garment 3 times for he does not know what has occurred in his absence and when he lies down he should supplicate: « In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants. » »
doua.phonetic: Bismika rabbî wa<u>d</u>a'tou janbî wa bika arfa'ouhou. Fa-in amsakta nafsî fa-r<u>h</u>amhâ, wa in arsaltahâ fa-<u>h</u>fa<u>z</u>hâ bi-mâ ta<u>h</u>fa<u>z</u>u bihi 'ibâdaka <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>âli<u>h</u>în.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهـَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسْألُكَ العَافِيَةَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take its life, to You belongs its life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take its life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant my good health. »
doua.reference: Muslim (#2712, 4/2083) and Ahmad (2/79).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innaka khalaqta nafsî wa anta tawaffâhâ. Laka mamâtouhâ wa ma<u>h</u>yâhâ. In a<u>h</u>yaytahâ fa-<u>h</u>fa<u>z</u>ha, wa in amattahâ fa--ghfirlahâ. Allâhoumma inni as alouka-l-'âfiyata.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذابَكَ، يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ (ثلاثاً)
doua.translation: « O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the day Your servants are resurrected. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5045, 4/311). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/143).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma qinî 'adhâbaka yawma tab'athou 'ibâdaka.

doua.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَموتُ وَأحْيَا
doua.translation: « In Your name O Allah, I live and die. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5045, 4/311). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/143
doua.phonetic: Bismika l-lâhoumma amûtou wa a<u>h</u>yâ.

doua.arabic:
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ (ثَلاثاً وثَلاثِينَ)
وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (ثَلاثاً وثَلاثِينَ)
وَاللهُ أكْبرُ (أربَعاً وثَلاثِينَ)
doua.translation:
« How Perfect is Allah [33 times].
All praise is for Allah [33 times].
Allah is the Greatest [34 times]. »
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>âna l-lâh (33 times), al-<u>h</u>amdoulillâh (33 times), allâhou akbar (34 times)

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الأرْضِ، وربَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيءٍ، فَالِقَ الحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالإنْجِيْلِ و الفُرْقَانِ، أَعوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ، وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الفَقْرِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, Lord of the 7 heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injil and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock. O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You. You are al-Ẓahir so there is nothing above You and You are al-Baṭin so there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty. »
doua.phonetic:
Allâhoumma rabba s-samâwâti s-sab'i wa rabba-l-'arshi-l-'azîmi ! Rabbanâ wa rabba koulli shay in ! Fâliqa-l-habbi wa n-nawâ wa mounzila t-tawrâti wa-l-injîli wa-l-fourqâni.
A'oûdhou bika min sharri koulli shay in anta âkhidhoun bi-nâsiyatihi. Allâhoumma anta-l-awwalou fa-laysa qablaka shay un. Wa anta-l-âkhirou fa-laysa ba'daka shay un.
Wa anta-z-zâhirou fa-laysa fawqaka shay un. Wa anta-l-bâtinou fa-laysa dounaka shay un. Iqdi 'annâ d-dayna wa aghninâ mina-l-faqri.

doua.arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
doua.translation: « All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them. »
doua.phonetic: Al hamdou li-l-lâhi l-lâdhi at'amanâ, wa saqânâ, wa kafânâ, wa âwânâ. Fa-kam mimman lâ kâfiya lahou wa lâ mou wî.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلَيْكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُـرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
doua.translation: « O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5083, 4/317). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/142).
doua.phonetic:
Allâhoumma 'âlim-alghaybi wa sh-shahâdati, fâtira s-samâwâti wa-l ardi,
rabba koulli shay in wa malîkahou. Ash-hadou anlâ ilâha illâ anta.
A'oûdhou bika min sharrin nafsî, wa min sharri sh-shaytâni wa 'hirkihi,
wa an aqtarifa 'alâ nafsî soû an ajourrahou ilâ Muslim(in).

doua.arabic: يَقْرَاُ ﴿ألم﴾ تَنْزِيْلَ السَّجْدَةِ، وَ تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ المُلْكَ
doua.translation: Recite Surah as-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk.
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3404) and an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#707). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#4873, 4/255).

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I submit my soul unto You, and I entrust my affair unto You, and I turn my face towards You, and I totally rely on You, in hope and fear of You. Verily there is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma aslamtou nafsî ilayka, wa fawwadtou amrpi ilayka, wa wajjahtou wajhî ilayka, wa alja tou <u>z</u>ahrî ilayka. Raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayka. Âmantou bi-kitâbika l-ladhî anzalta wa bi-nabiyyika l-ladhî arsalta.

group.title: Turning around at night when sleeping or changing sides
group.version: When we change sides at night while sleeping

doua.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ الوَاحِدُ القَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا العَزِيْزُ الغَـفَّارُ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, the One, al-Qahhar. Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, the Exalted in Might, the Oft-Forgiving. »
doua.reference: al-Hakim (1/540) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him, an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#864) and Ibn al-sounni in son 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#757). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#4693, 4/213).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou-l-wâ<u>h</u>idou-l-qahhârou, rabbou s-samâwâti wa-l-ar<u>d</u>i wa mâ baynahoumâ-l-'azîzu-l-ghaffar.

group.title: In case of restlessness and fear during sleep
group.version: When you want to protect yourself before sleeping

doua.arabic: أَعُوذُبِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ، مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ، وَأنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
doua.translation: « I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#3893, 4/12). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/171).
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou bi-kalimâti l-lâhi t-tâmmâti min gha<u>d</u>abihi, wa 'iqâbihi, wa sharri 'ibâdihi, wa min hamazâti sh-shayâ<u>t</u>îni, wa an ya<u>h</u><u>d</u>ouroûni.

group.title: When you have a bad dream or a nightmare

doua.arabic:
يَنْفُثُ عَن يَسَارِهِ (ثَلاثاً).
يَسْتَعِيْذُ بِااللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَى (ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ).
لَا يُحَدِّثُ بِهَا أحَداً.
يتحَوَّلُ عَنْ جَنْبِهِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ
doua.translation:
« Summary of what to do upon seeing a bad dream:
(1) Spit on your left 3 times.
(2) Seek refuge with Allah from Shayṭan and the evil of what you saw, 3 times.
(3) Do not relate the dream to anyone.
(4) Turn and sleep on the opposite side of that which you were previously on. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#7044) and Muslim (#2261, 4/1772).
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou billâhi mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni r-rajîm.

doua.arabic: يَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إنْ أرَادَ ذَلِكَ
doua.translation: « Get up and pray if you so desire. »

group.title: Qunut al-Witr during prayer
group.version: During the Witr Prayer Qunout

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيْمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيْمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيْمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيْمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ والَيْتَ، [وَ لَا يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to, and bless for me that which You have bestowed. Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You. For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honored and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1425), at-Tirmidhi (#464), an-Nasai (1/252), Ibn Majah (#1178), Ahmad (1/200), ad-Darimi (1/373), al-Hakim (3/172), and al-Bayhaqi (2/209, 497, 498). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (1/144), Sahih Ibn Majah (1/194), and Irwa' al-Ghalil (2/172).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma hdinî fîman hadayta wa 'âfinî fîman 'âfayta, wa tawallanî fîman tawallayta, wa bârik lî fîmâ a'<u>t</u>ayta, wa qinî sharra mâ qa<u>d</u>ayta. Fa-innaka taq<u>d</u>î wa lâ youq<u>d</u>â 'alayka. Innahou lâ yadhillou man wâlayta [wa lâ ya'izzu man 'âdayta]. Tabârakata rabbanâ wa ta'âlayta.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1427), at-Tirmidhi (#3561), an-Nasai (1/252), Ibn Majah (#1179), and Ahmad (1/96, 118, 150). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/180), Sahih Ibn Majah (1/194) and Irwa' al-Ghalil (2/175).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oudhou bi-ri<u>d</u>âka min sakha<u>t</u>tika, wa bi-mou'âfâtika min 'ouqûbatika. Wa a'oûdhou bika minka. Lâ u<u>h</u><u>s</u> thanâ an 'alayka, anta kama athnayta 'alâ nafsik.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِيْنَ ملْحَقٌ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِيْنُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الخَيْرَ، وَلَا نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفُرُكَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers. O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You. We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You. »
doua.reference: Al-Bayhaqi in as-sounan al-koubra (2/211). Al-Albani a dit in Irwa' al-Ghalil (2/170) que sa chaine est sahih and la narration est mawqoufa to par Omar.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma iyyâka na'boudou, wa laka nou<u>s</u>allî wa nasjoudou, wa ilayka nas'â wa na<u>h</u>fidou, najroû ra<u>h</u>mataka wa nakhshâ 'adhâbaka, inna 'adhâbaka bi-l-kâfirîna moul<u>h</u>aqoun. Allâhoumma innâ nasta'înouka wa nastaghfirouka, wa nouthnî 'alayka-l-khayra wa lâ nakfourouka, wa nou minou bika, wa nakh<u>d</u>a'ou laka, wa nakhla'ou man yakfourouka.

group.title: Right after the witr prayer salam

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ (ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، وَ الثَّالِثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بِهَا وَيَمُدُّ صَوْتَهُ يَقُولُ : [ ربِّ المَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ])
doua.translation: « How perfect the King, the Holy One is (3 times, and on the third time the Prophet would raise his voice, elongate it and add: [Lord of the angels and the Ruḥ]). »
doua.reference: an-Nasai (3/244), ad-Daraqoutni (2/31) and l'extension entre parenthèses vient de lui and sa chaîne est sahiha (1/337).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>âna-l-maliki-l-qouddousi. [Rabbi-l-malâ ikati wa r-roûhi.]

group.title: Against anxiety, sorrow and grief
group.version: When you're sad

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيْعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
doua.translation: « O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Qurʾan the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (1/391). Al-Albani authenticated it in al-Kalim at-Tayyib (#124).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî 'abdouka, ibnou 'abdika, ibnou amatika. Nâ<u>s</u>iyatî bi-yadika. Mâ<u>d</u>in fiyya <u>h</u>ukmouka, 'adloun fiyya qa<u>d</u>â uka. As alouka bi-koulli smin houwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahou fî kitâbika, aw 'allamtahou a<u>h</u>adan min khalqika, aw ista tharta bihi fî 'ilmi-l-ghaybi 'indaka, an taj'ala-l-qour âna rabî'a qalbî, wa nûra <u>s</u>sadrî, wa jalâ a <u>h</u>uznî, wa dhahâba hammî.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَمِّ وَ الْحَـزَنِ، والعَجْـزِ والكَسَلِ، والبُخْلِ والجُبْنِ، وضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#6363, 7/158), voir Fath al-Bari (11/173).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika mina-l-hammi wa-l-<u>h</u>azani, wa-l-'ajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-boukhli wa-l-joubni, wa <u>d</u>ala'i d-dayni wa ghalabati r-rijâl.

group.title: For a person in distress
group.version: When you're in a panic state

doua.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظِيْمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ العَرْشِ الكَرِيْمِ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, the Magnificent, Forbearing. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth and Lord of the noble throne. »
doua.phonetic: <u>H</u>asbouna l-lâhou, wa ni'ma-l-wakîl.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجـُو، فَلا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْتَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshiped except You. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5090, 4/324) and Ahmad (5/42). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (3/959).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ra<u>h</u>mataka arjû. Falâ takilnî ilâ nafsî <u>t</u>arfata 'aynin, wa a<u>s</u>li<u>h</u> lî sha nî koullahou. Lâ ilâha illâ anta.

doua.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ، إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except You. How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrongdoers. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3505, 5/529) and al-Hakim (1/505) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him. Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/168).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ anta, Soub<u>h</u>ânaka, innî kountou mina <u>z</u>-<u>z</u>âlimîn.

doua.arabic: اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
doua.translation: « Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1525, 2/87). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/335).
doua.phonetic: Allâhou, Allâhou rabbî. Lâ ushrikou bihi shay an.

group.title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهـِمْ
doua.translation: « O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1537, 2/89) and al-Hakim (2/142) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innâ naj'alouka fî nou<u>h</u>û rihim, wa na'oûdhou bika min shouroûrihim.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيْرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ، وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#2632, 3/42) and at-Tirmidhi (#3584, 5/572). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/183).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma anta 'â<u>d</u>oudî, wa anta na<u>s</u>îrî. Bika ajûlou, wa bika a<u>s</u>soûlou, wa bika uqâtil.

doua.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللهُ، وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيْلُ
doua.translation: « Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (He is). »
doua.phonetic: <u>H</u>asbouna l-lâhou, wa ni'ma-l-wakîl.

group.title: For fear of the oppression of the rulers and leaders

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَ رَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيْمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ، وَ أَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلائِقِكَ؛ أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنهُمْ أوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَ جَلَّ ثَنَائُكَ، وَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, Lord of the 7 heavens and the earth and the great throne, protect me from so-and-so [mention the name of the person] and from his allies among your creatures, and from being subjected by their abuse or tyranny. Honored is your protected, exalted is your praise, none has the right to be worshiped except You. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-moufrad (#707) and al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih al-Adab al-moufrad (#545).
doua.phonetic: <![CDATA[Allâhoumma rabba s-samâwâti s-sab'i, wa rabba-l-'arshi-l-'a<u>z</u>îmi. koun lî jâran min (mentionner la personne) wa a<u>h</u>zabihi min khalâ iqika, an yafrou<u>t</u>a 'alayya a<u>h</u>adoun minhoum wa ya<u>t</u>ghâ.'Azza jârouka, wa jalla thanâ uka, wa lâ ilâha illâ ant.

doua.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيْعًا، اللهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَ أَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ باللهِ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وُجُنُودِهِ وَ أَتْبَاعِهِ وَ أَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَارًا مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُك، وَ عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ : وَ لَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ. [ثَلاثَ مَرَّاتٍ]
doua.translation: « Allah is the greatest, Allah is mightier than all things. Allah is mightier than the one I am afraid of and I mistrust. I take refuge in Allah, none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, who hold back the 7 heavens from falling on earth except when he will allow this, from the misdeeds of Your slave so-and-so [mention the name of the person], from his soldiers, and from his partisans among the jinns and the human beings. O Lord! Be my protector from their misdeeds. Exalted is Your praise, honored is Your protected, blessed is Your name and none has the right to be worshiped except You. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari in al-Adab al-moufrad (#708) and al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih al-Adab al-moufrad (#546).
doua.phonetic: Allâhou akbarou. Allâhou a'azzu min khalqihi jamî'an. Allâhou a'azzu mimmâ akhâfou wa a<u>h</u>dharou. A'oûdhou billâhi l-ladhî lâ ilâha illâ houwa-l-moumsiki s-samâwâti s-sab'i an yaqa'na 'alâ-l-ar<u>d</u>i illâ bi-idhnihi, min sharri 'abdika (mentionner la personne) wa jounûdihi wa atbâ'ihi wa ashyâ'ihi mina-l-jinni wa-l-insi. Allâhoumma koun lî jâran min sharrihim. Jalla thanâ uka wa 'azza ârouka, wa tabâraka smouka, wa lâ ilâha ghayrouka.

group.title: Against his enemies
group.version: To defeat enemies and adversaries

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيْعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَ زَلْزِلْهُمْ
doua.translation: « O Allah, Revealer of the Book, swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ! mounzila-l-kitâbi, sarî'a-l-<u>h</u>isâbi ! Ihzimi-l-a<u>h</u>zâba. Allâhoumma hzimhoum wa zalzilhoum.

group.title: When you are afraid of a group of people

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma kfinîhim bimâ shi ta.

group.title: For someone who doubts their belief
group.version: When we doubt that we have faith

doua.arabic:
(1) يَسْتَعِيْذُ بِاللهِ
(2) يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا وَسْوَسَ فِيْهِ
doua.translation:
(1) Seek refuge with Allah from Shayťan.
(2) Renounce that which is causing such doubt.
doua.reference: This passage is taken from Fath al-Bari (#3276, 6/336). Also see Muslim (#134, #214, 1/120).
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou billâhi mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni r-rajîm.

doua.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
doua.translation: « I have believed in Allah and His Messenger. »
doua.phonetic: Âmantou billâhi wa rousoûlihi.

doua.arabic: ﴿هُوَ الأوَّلُ وَالآخِـرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾
doua.translation: « He is the First and the Last, al-Ẓahir and al-Batin, and He knows well all things. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5110, 4/329) and al-Albani declared it hassan in Sahih Abi Dawud (3/962).
doua.phonetic: houwa-l-awwalou wa-l-âkhirou wa <u>z</u>-<u>z</u>âhirou wa-l-bâ<u>t</u>inou, wa houwa bi-koulli shay in 'alîm.

group.title: For debt settlement
group.version: Getting rid of debt

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3563, 5/650). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/180).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma kfinî bi-<u>h</u>alâlika 'an <u>h</u>arâmika wa ghninî bi-fa<u>d</u>lika 'amman siwâk.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَمِّ وَ الْحَـزَنِ، والعَجْزِ والكَسَلِ، والبُخْلِ والجُبْنِ، وضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَال
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika mina-l-hammi wa-l-<u>h</u>azani, wa-l-'ajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-l-boukhli wa-l-joubni, wa <u>d</u>dala'i d-dayni wa ghalabati r-rijâl.

group.title: For those who have waswas during prayer
group.version: Not to be devolved in prayer

doua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ، واتْفُلْ عَلَى يَساَرِكَ [ثَلاثاً]
doua.translation: « I seek refuge in Allah from Shayṭan the Accursed. » (dry spit on your left side 3 times)
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou billâhi mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni r-rajîm.

group.title: Before an exam, an interview, something difficult

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
doua.translation: « O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy. »
doua.reference: Ibn Hibban in son Sahih (#2427), Mawarid and Ibn al-sounni (#351). Ibn Hajar a dit : « Le hadith est sahih. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma lâ sahla illâ mâ ja'altahou sahlan, wa anta taj'alou-l-<u>h</u>azana idhâ shi ta sahlan.

group.title: Upon committing a sin

doua.arabic: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذْنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُاللهَ إلَّا غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهُ
doua.translation: Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays 2 rak'ahs of salah and then seeks Allah's forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1521, 2/86) and at-Tirmidhi (#406, #3006, 2/257). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (1/283).

group.title: For expelling the devil and his whisperings

doua.arabic: الاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللهِ مِنْهُ
doua.translation: Seek refuge in Allah from him.
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (1/206) and at-Tirmidhi. Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (1/77).
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou billâhi mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni r-rajîm.

doua.arabic: الأذَانُ
doua.translation: The Athan (call to prayer).
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#608, 1/151) and Muslim (#389, 1/291).

doua.arabic: الأذْكَارُ وَ قِراءَةُ القُرْآنِ
doua.translation: « Authentic texts of remembrance and the recitation of the Qurʾan. »

group.title: In the event of an accident
group.version: When something happens to us

doua.arabic: قَدَرُ اللهِ وَما شَاءَ فَعَلَ
doua.translation: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.
doua.phonetic: Qaddarou l-lâhi wa mâ shâ a fa'ala.

group.title: To congratulate someone on a birth

doua.arabic:
بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَ شَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَ بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَ رُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ المُهَنَّأ فَيَقُولُ : بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ، وَ بَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وجَزَاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللهُ مِثْلَهُ، وأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
doua.translation:
« May Allah bless what He allots to you (this child) and may you be grateful to the One who allots him to you. May he (this child) come to maturity and may Allah allot him the good behaviour towards you. »
Reply: « May Allah bless every thing that He allots to you! May Allah reward you by His forgiveness, allot a new-born like mine to you and give you an abundant retribution. »
doua.reference: an-Nawawi in al-Adhkar (p.349). Also see Sahih al-Adhkar de an-Nawawi (2/713) par Shaykh Salim al-Hilali.
doua.phonetic:
Bâraka l-lâhou laka fî-l-mawhoûbi laka, wa shakarta-l-wâhiba, wa balagha ashouddahou, wa rouziqta birrahou.
Bâraka l-lâhou laka, wa bâraka 'alayka, wa jazâka l-lâhou khayran, wa razaqaka l-lâhou mithlahou, wa ajzala thawâbaka.

group.title: To place children under the protection of Allah

doua.arabic: أُعِيْذُكُمَ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهـَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لامَّةٍ
doua.translation: « I commend you to the protection of Allah's perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye. »
doua.phonetic: U'îdhoukoum bi-kalimâti l-lâhi t-tâmmati min koulli shay<u>t</u>ânin wa hâmmatin, wa min koulli 'aynin lâmmatin.

group.title: When we visit a sick, what we tell them

doua.arabic: لَا بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ
doua.translation: « Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills. »
doua.phonetic: Lâ ba sa, <u>t</u>ahoûroun in shâ a l-lâhou.

doua.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللهَ العَظِيْمَ، رَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيْمِ، أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ [سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ]
doua.translation: « I ask Allah the Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you. » (7 times)
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#2083) and Abu Dawud (#3106). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (2/210) and Sahih al Jami' (#5766, 5/180).
doua.phonetic: As alou l-lâha-l-'a<u>z</u>îma, rabba-l-'arshi-l-'a<u>z</u>îmi, an yashfiyaka.

group.title: The merit of visiting a sick person
group.version: The reward of visiting a sick person

doua.arabic: إذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أخَاهُ المُسْلِمَ، مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ ألْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، و إنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ ألْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ
doua.translation: If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angels send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angels send prayers upon him until the morning.
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#969), Ibn Majah (#1442) and Ahmad (1/97). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (1/244) and Sahih at-Tirmidhi (1/286). Shaykh Ahmad Shakir also authenticated it.

group.title: For the patient who no longer believes in his chances of staying alive
group.version: When the patient knows he is going to die

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيْقِ الأعْلَى
doua.translation: « O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the higher companions. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir lî, wa r<u>h</u>amnî, wa al<u>h</u>iqnî bi-r-rafîqi-l-a'lâ.

doua.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، إِنَّ للمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, death does indeed contain agony. »
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou. Inna li-l-mawti la-sakarâtin.

doua.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وحْدَهُ، لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لهُ، لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ ولَهُ الحَمْدُ، لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah and Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3430) and Ibn Majah (#3794). Al-Albani authenticated it. Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/152) and Sahih Ibn Majah (2/317).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou wa l-lâhou akbar. Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou wa<u>h</u>dahou. Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou. Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-<u>h</u>amdou. Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa lâ <u>h</u>awla wa lâ qouwwata illâ billâhi.

group.title: For someone who is dying
group.version: When we are on the verge of death

doua.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ
doua.translation: « He, whose last words are « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, » will enter Jannah. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#3116, 3/190). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#6479, 5/432).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâh

group.title: For those who suffer from calamity or death
group.version: Upon death or mussiba

doua.arabic: إِنَّا لِلّهَِ وَ إِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيْبَتِي، وَ أخْلِفْ لِي خَيْراً مِنْهَا
doua.translation: « To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better. »
doua.phonetic: Innâ li-l-lâhi wa innâ ilayhi râji'ouna. Allahoumma journî mou<u>s</u>îbatî wa khlouf lî khayran minhâ.

group.title: By closing the deceased's eyes

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلانٍ (باسْمِهِ)، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ في المَهْدِيِّيْنَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ في عَقِبِهِ في الغَابِرِيْنَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِيْنَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ في قَبْرِهِ وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيْهِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, forgive (mention the name of the deceased) and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir li-(nommer la personne) wa rfa' darajatahou fî-l-mahdiyyîna, wa khloufhou fî 'aqibihi fî-l-ghâbirîna. Wa ghfir lanâ wa lahou, yâ rabba-l-'âlamîna, wa fsa<u>h</u> lahou fî qabrihi wa nawwir lahou fîhi.

group.title: For the deceased at funeral prayer
group.version: For a dead man during salat al janaza

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّـلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ داراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ(وَ عَذَابِ النَّارِ)
doua.translation: « O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave (and the torment of the Fire). »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir lahou wa r<u>h</u>amhou wa 'âfihi, wa 'fou 'anhou, wa akrim nouzulahou, wa wassi' moudkhalahou, wa ghsilhou bi-l-mâ i wa th-thalji wa-l-baradi. Wa naqqihi mina-l-kha<u>t</u>âya kamâ naqqayta th-thawba-l-abya<u>d</u>a mina d-danasi. Wa abdilhou dâran khayran min dârihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi, wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi. Wa dkhilhou-l-jannata wa a'idh-hou min 'adhâbi-l-qaqbr [wa 'adhâbi n-nâr].

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا، وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا، وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيْرِنَا، وَكَبِيْرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا، وَأُنْثَانَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيْمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then land such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then land such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not land us stray after him. »
doua.reference: Ibn Majah (#1498, 1/480), Abu Dawud (#3201), at-Tirmidhi (#1024), an-Nasai (#1988) and Ahmad (2/368). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (1/251).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir li-<u>h</u>ayyinâ wa mayyitinâ, wa shâhidinâ wa ghâ ibinâ, wa <u>s</u>aghîrinâ wa kabîrinâ, wa dhakarinâ wa unthânâ. Allâhoumma man a<u>h</u>yaytahou minnâ fa-a<u>h</u>yihi 'alâ-l-islâmi. Wa man tawaffaytahou minnâ fa-tawaffahou 'alâ-l-îmâni. Allâhoumma lâ ta<u>h</u>rimnâ ajrahou wa la tou<u>d</u>illabâ ba'dahou.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلانَ بْنَ فُلانٍ في ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ، وَارْحَمْهُ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيْمُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, (name) is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful. »
doua.reference: Ibn Majah (#1499) and Abu Dawud (3/211). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (1/251).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma inna (mentionner la personne) fî dhimmatika wa <u>h</u>abli jiwârika. Fa-qihi min fitnati-l-qabri wa 'adhâbi n-nâri. Wa anta ahlou-l-wafâ i wa-l-<u>h</u>haqqi. Fa-ghfir lahou wa r<u>h</u>amhou, innaka anta-l-ghafoûrou r-ra<u>h</u>îm.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، احْتَاجَ إِلى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ في حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيْئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then overlook his sins. »
doua.reference: al-Hakim (1/359) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him. Also see Ahkam al-Janaʾiz par al-Albani (p.125).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma 'abdouka wa bnou amatika i<u>h</u>tâja ilâ ra<u>h</u>matika. Wa anta ghaniyyoun 'an 'adhâbihi. In kâna mou<u>h</u>sinan, fa-zid fî <u>h</u>asanâtihi. Wa in kâna mousî an fa-tajâwaz 'anhou.

group.title: When the deceased is a child at the janaza
group.version: When praying for a dead child

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيْعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِيْنَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجـُورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ المُؤْمِنِيْنَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ في كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهـِيْمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ، و أبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، و أهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أهْلِهِ، اللهم اغْفِرْ لأسْلاَفِنَا، وَ أفْرَاطِنَا، وَ مَنْ سَبَقَنَا باِلإيْمَانِ
doua.translation: « O Lord, protect him from the punishment of the grave. O Lord, make him a preceding reward and a stored treasure for his parents, and an answered intercessor. O Allah, through him, make heavy their scales and magnify their reward. Unite him with the righteous believers, place him under the care of Ibrahim, and protect him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him in exchange a better residence and a better family than his. O Allah, forgive our ancestors and our descendants and those who came before us with faith. »
doua.reference: Voir al-moughni par Ibn qoudamah (3/416) and ad-dourus al-mouhimmah li 'amah al-Ummah (p.15) par Shaykh Ibn Baz.
doua.phonetic:
Allâhoumma a'idh-hou min 'adhâbi-l-qabr.
Allâhoumma j'alhou faratan wa dhoukran li-wâlidayhi, wa shafî'an moujâban. Allâhoumma thaqqil bihi mawâzînahoumâ, wa a'zim bihi ijûrahoumâ, wa alhiqhou bi-sâlihi-l-mou minîna. Wa j'alhou fî kafâlati Ibrâhîma, wa qihi bi-rahmatika 'adhâba-l-jahîmi. Wa abdilhou dâran khayran min dârihi, wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi. Allâhoumma ghfir li-aslâfinâ wa afrâtinâ wa man sabaqanâ bi-l-îmân

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً
doua.translation: « O Allah, make him a preceding reward, a prepayment and a recompense for us. »
doua.reference: Al-Baghawi in Sharh al-sounnah (5/357).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma j'alhou lanâ fara<u>t</u>an wa salafan wa ajran.

group.title: To offer condolences
group.version: When we offer condolences

doua.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّىً...فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَ لْتَحْتَسِبْ
doua.translation: « Verily to Allah belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#1284, 2/80) and Muslim (#923, 2/636).
doua.phonetic:
Inna li-l-lâhi mâ akhadha wa li-l-lâhi mâ a'tâ, wa koullou shay in 'indahou bi-ajalin mousammân... Fa-l-tasbir wa-l-tahtasib.

A'zama l-lâhou ajraka, wa ahsana 'azâ ka, wa ghafara li-mayyitika.

group.title: When the deceased is placed in the grave

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللهِ
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah and upon the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#3213, 3/314) with a Sahih chain and Ahmad (2/40) with the phrase : (بسم الله و على ملة رسول الله) and its chain is Sahih.
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi wa 'alâ sounnati rasoûli l-lâhi.

group.title: After burying the deceased
group.version: After the funeral of a dead man

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, forgive him, O Allah, protect him. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#3221, 3/315) and al-Hakim (1/370) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir lahou, Allâhoumma thabbit-hou.

group.title: When we visit the graves
group.version: When visiting a cemetery

doua.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ المُؤْمِنِيْنَ، وَالْمُسْلِمِيْنَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، [وَ يَرْ حَمُ اللهُ المُسْتَقْدِمِيْنَ مِنَّا وَ المُسْتَأخِرِيْنَ] أسْألُ اللهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ العَافِيَةَ
doua.translation: « Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you, we ask Allah for well-being for us and you. »
doua.reference: Muslim (#975, 2/671) and Ibn Majah (#1547, 1/494) and the wording is his. What is between the brackets is from the hadith of 'aʾishah collected par Muslim (#974, 2/671).
doua.phonetic: As-salâmou 'alaykoum ahla d-diyâri mina-l-mouminîna wa-l-Muslimîna. Wa innâ in shâ a l-lâhou bikoum lâ<u>h</u>iqûna [wa yar<u>h</u>amou l-lâhou-l-moustaqdimîna minnâ wa-l-mousta khirîna.] As alou l-lâha lanâ wa lakoumou-l-'âfiyata.

group.title: When the wind blows or during a storm
group.version: During a storm or tornado

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You for its goodness and I take refuge with You from its evil. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5097, 4/326) and Ibn Majah (#3727, 2/1228). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/305).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka khayrahâ wa a'oûdhou bika min sharrihâ.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيْهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا اُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيْهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا اُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from its evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with. »
doua.reference: Muslim (#899, 2/616) and al-Bukhari (#3206, 4/76).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka khayrahâ wa khayra mâ fîhâ, wa khayra mâ oursilat bihi. Wa a'oûdhou bika min sharrihâ, wa sharri mâ fîhâ, wa sharri mâ oursilat bihi.

group.title: When we hear thunder
group.version: When there is a thunderstorm

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ، وَالمَلائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيْفَتِهِ
doua.translation: « How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angels out of fear of Him. »
doua.reference: Al-mouwatta (2/992) and al-Albani.
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>âna l-ladhî yousabbi<u>h</u>u r-ra'dou bi-<u>h</u>amdihi wa-l-malâ ikatou min khîfatihi.

group.title: To Get the rain
group.version: When we need the rain

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيْثاً مَرِيْئاً مَرِيْعاً، نَافِعاً، غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
doua.translation: « O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1169, 1/303). Al-Albani declared it sahih in Sahih Abu Dawud (1/216).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma sqinâ ghaytan moughîthan, marî an, mourî'an, nâfi'an ghayra <u>d</u>ârrin, 'âjilan ghayra âjilin.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
doua.translation: « O Allah, relieve us. O Allah, relieve us. O Allah, relieve us. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#1013, 1/224) and Muslim (#897, 2/613).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma aghithnâ. Allâhoumma aghithnâ. Allâhoumma aghithnâ.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِيْ بَلَدَكَ المَيِّتَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1176, 1/305) and al-Albani declared it hassan in Sahih Abu Dawud (1/218).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma sqi 'ibâdaka wa bahâ imaka. Wa bshour ra<u>h</u>mataka, wa a<u>h</u>yi baladaka-l-mayyita.

group.title: When it rains
group.version: When the rain falls

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً
doua.translation: « O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma <u>s</u>ayyiban nâfi'an.

group.title: After it rained
group.version: When the rain stops

doua.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
doua.translation: « We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#846, 1/205) and Muslim (#71, 1/83).
doua.phonetic: mou<u>t</u>irnâ bi-fa<u>d</u>li l-lâhi wa ra<u>h</u>matihi.

group.title: To ask for skies
group.version: When you are afraid of the rain damage

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الأوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, land the rain fall around us and not upon us. O Allah, (land it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#1013, 1/224) and Muslim (#897, 2/614).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma <u>h</u>awâlaynâ wa lâ 'alaynâ. Allâhoumma 'alâ-l-âkâmi wa <u>z</u>-<u>z</u>irâbi wa bou<u>t</u>ûni-l-awdiyati wa manâbiti sh-shajari.

group.title: By locating the crescent of the new moon
group.version: When we see the new moon

doua.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالأمْنِ وَالإيْمَانِ، والسَّلامَةِ والإسْلامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيْقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللهُ
doua.translation: « Allah is the greatest. O Allah, land the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3451, 5/405) and ad-Darimi (1/336). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/157).
doua.phonetic: Allâhou akbar. Allâhoumma ahillahou 'alaynâ bi-l-amni, wa-l-îmâni, wa s-salâmati, wa-l-islâmi, wa t-tawfîqi limâ tou<u>h</u>ibbou rabbanâ wa tar<u>d</u>â. Rabbounâ wa rabbouka l-lâhou.

group.title: Upon breaking fast
group.version: During iftar, breaking the fast

doua.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ
doua.translation: « The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#2357, 2/306). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#4678, 4/209).
doua.phonetic: Dhahaba <u>z</u>-<u>z</u>ama u wa btallati-l-'ouroûqou wa thabata-l-ajrou in shâ a l-lâhou.

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me. »
doua.reference: Ibn Majah (#1753, 1/557) and al-Hafiẓ declared it hassan in son takhrij of al-Adhkar. Also see Sharh al-Adhkar (4/342).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka bi-ra<u>h</u>matika l-lâti wasi'at koulla shay in an taghfira lî.

group.title: Before eating
group.version: At the start of the meal

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ (في أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ)
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah (in its beginning and end).^[The words in the brackand are to be said if one forgets to recite the du'a before eating and remembers while eating.] »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#3767, 3/347) and at-Tirmidhi (#1858, 4/288). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (2/167).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi. (Bismillâhi fî awwalihi wa âkhirihi).

doua.arabic:
(١) اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْهِ، وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ
(٢) اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْهِ، وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
doua.translation:
(1) « O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it. »
If one is given milk, recite the following instead:
(2) « O Allah, bless it fo it for usand give us more of it. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#3767) and an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#282). Al-Albani declared it faible, voir al-Kalim at-Tayyib (#184).
doua.phonetic:
Allâhoumma bârik lanâ fîhi, wa at'imnâ khayran minhou.
Allâhoumma bârik lanâ fîhi wa zidnâ minhou.

group.title: Upon completion of a meal, after eating
group.version: At the end of the meal

doua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هـَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيْهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
doua.translation: « All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#4023), at-Tirmidhi (#3458) and Ibn Majah (#3285). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/159).
doua.phonetic: Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi ladhî a<u>t</u>'amanî hâdhâ wa razaqanîhi min ghayrin <u>h</u>awlin minnî wa lâ qouwwatin.

doua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيْراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيْهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنىً عَنْهُ رَبُّنَا
doua.translation: « Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#5458, 6/214) and at-Tirmidhi (#3456, 5/507).
doua.phonetic: Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi <u>h</u>amdan kathîran, <u>t</u>ayyiban, moubârakan fîhi, ghayra makfiyyin wa lâ mouwadda'in, wa lâ moustaghnan 'anhou rabbanâ.

group.title: Of the guest for the host

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيْمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ، وَارْحَمْهُمْ
doua.translation: « O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma bârik lahoum fîmâ razaqtahoum wa ghfir lahoum wa r<u>h</u>amhoum.

group.title: To those who offer food or drink

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
doua.translation: « O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma a<u>t</u>'im man a<u>t</u>'amanî wa sqi man saqânî.

group.title: When someone breaks the fast at someone's home

doua.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الأبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ المَلائِكَةُ
doua.translation: « May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angels send prayers upon you. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#3854, 3/367), Ibn Majah (#1747, 1/556) and an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah [296-298]. Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (2/730).
doua.phonetic: Af<u>t</u>ara 'indakoumou <u>s</u>-<u>s</u>â imûna, wa akala <u>t</u>a'âmakoumou-l-abrârou, wa <u>s</u>allat 'alaykoumou-l-malâ ikatou.

group.title: By the faster when he is presented with something to eat and he does not break his fast
group.version: When we are fasting and we are invited to eat

doua.arabic: إذَا دُعِيَ أحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإنْ كَانَ صَائِمًا فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَ إنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ (وَ مَعنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ؛ أيْ : فَلْيَدْعُ)
doua.translation: « If you are invited (to a meal) then accept. If you happen to be fasting, then pray (for those present) and if you are not fasting, then eat. (The meaning of ‘pray’ here means ‘supplicate’). »

group.title: If you Get insulted during the fast

doua.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
doua.translation: « I am fasting, I am fasting. »
doua.phonetic: Innî <u>s</u>âim. Innî <u>s</u>âim.

group.title: Seeing the first fruits, or not yand ripe

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِيْنَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا
doua.translation: « O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our sa' for us and bless our mudd for us. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma bârik lanâ fî thamarinâ, wa bârik lanâ fî madînatinâ, wa bârik lanâ fî <u>s</u>â'inâ, wa bârik lanâ fî mouddinâ.

group.title: When we sneeze
group.version: When sneezing

doua.arabic:
(١) الْحَمْدُ للهِ
(٢) يَرْحَمُكَ اللهُ
(٣) يَهْدِيْكُمُ اللهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
doua.translation:
« When one of you sneezes, say:
(1) « All praise if for Allah, » then his brother or companion should reply:
(2) « May Allah have mercy upon you. » and the one who sneezed replies by saying
(3) « May Allah guide you and rectify your condition. » »
doua.phonetic:
- Alhamdoulillâhi.
- Yarhamouka l-lâhou.
- Yahdîkoumou l-lâhou wa youslihu bâlakoum.

group.title: To a kafir who praises Allah after sneezing

doua.arabic: يَهْدِيْكُمُ اللهُ، وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
doua.translation: « May Allah guide you and rectify your condition. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#2739, 5/82), Ahmad (4/400) and Abu Dawud (#5038, 4/308). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (2/354).
doua.phonetic: Yahdîkoumou l-lâhou wa you<u>s</u>li<u>h</u>u bâlakoum.

group.title: For the newlyweds
group.version: At the halal religious wedding

doua.arabic: بَارَكَ اللّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
doua.translation: « May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#2130), at-Tirmidhi (#1091), and Ibn Majah (#1905). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (1/324).
doua.phonetic: Bâraka l-lâhou laka, wa bâraka 'alayka, wa jama'a baynakoumâ fî khayrin.

group.title: At the wedding night
group.version: After getting married

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#2160, 2/248) and Ibn Majah (#1918, 1/617). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (1/324).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî as alouka khayrahâ, wa khayra mâ jabaltahâ 'alayhi. Wa a'oûdhou bika min sharrihâ wa sharri mâ jabaltahâ 'alayhi.

group.title: Before intimate intercourse

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with. »
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi. Allâhoumma jannibnâ sh-shay<u>t</u>âna, wa jannibi sh-shay<u>t</u>âna mâ razaqtanâ.

group.title: When angry

doua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
doua.translation: « I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil. »
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou billâhi mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni r-rajîm.

group.title: Upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation

doua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيْرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيْلاً
doua.translation: « All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favored me over much of His creation. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3432, 5/493, 494). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/153).
doua.phonetic: Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi l-ladhî 'âfânî mimmâ btalâka bihi wa fa<u>d</u><u>d</u>alanî 'alâ kathîrin mimman khalaqa taf<u>d</u>îlan.

group.title: During a session or a gathering

doua.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لي، وَتُبْ عَلَـيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ
doua.translation: « O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). Verily You are the Oft-Returning, the Oft-Forgiving. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3432). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/153) and Sahih Ibn Majah (2/321).
doua.phonetic: Rabbi ghfir lî wa toub 'alayya. Innaka anta t-tawwâbou-l-ghafoûr.

group.title: For the atonement for sins after a gathering
group.version: To close a discussion, a meeting, a speech

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
doua.translation: « How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. I bear witness that None has the right to be worshiped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#4859), at-Tirmidhi (#3433), and an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#397). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/153).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânaka l-lâhoumma wa bi-<u>h</u>amdika. Ash-hadou an lâ ilâha illâ anta, astaghfirouka wa atûbou ilayka.

group.title: To respond to a request for forgiveness

doua.arabic: وَلَكَ
doua.translation: « And (may Allah forgive) you. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (5/82) and an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (p.218).
doua.phonetic: Wa laka.

group.title: To the one who does you a favor

doua.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً
doua.translation: « May Allah reward you with good. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#2035). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#6244) and Sahih at-Tirmidhi (2/200).
doua.phonetic: Jazâka l-lâhou khayran.

group.title: To protect yourself from the Dajjal, doua against the Dajjal
group.version: To protect yourself from the False Messiah

doua.arabic: مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشَرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أوُّلِ سُورَةِ الكَهْفِ، عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ
doua.translation: « Whoever memorises the first ten verses of Surah al-Kahf will be protected from the Dajjal. »

group.title: When someone says he loves us in Allah

doua.arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِيْ أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
doua.translation: « May He, for whom you have loved me, love you. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5125, 4/333) and al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (3/965).
doua.phonetic: A<u>h</u>abbaka l-ladhî a<u>h</u>babtanî lahou.

group.title: For those who donate

doua.arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِكَ
doua.translation: « May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5125, 4/333) and al-Albani declared it hassan in Sahih Abi Dawud (3/965).
doua.phonetic: Bâraka l-lâhou laka fî ahlika wa mâlika.

group.title: When settling a debt to its debtor

doua.arabic: بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ والأَدَاءُ
doua.translation: « May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan. »
doua.reference: an-Nasai in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#372, p.300) and Ibn Majah (#2424, 2/809). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/55).
doua.phonetic: Bâraka l-lâhou laka fî ahlika wa mâlika. Innamâ jazâ u s-salafi-l-<u>h</u>amdou wa-l-adâ .

group.title: When we are afraid of chirk or falling into the association
group.version: When you fear falling into the shirk

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُبِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
doua.translation: « O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (4/403). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#3731, 3/233) and Sahih at-Targhib wa at-Tarhib (#36, 1/122) par al-Albani.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika an ushrika bika wa anâ a'lamou, wa astaghfirouka li-mâ lâ a'lam.

group.title: To respond to someone who thanks us

doua.arabic: وَفِيْكَ بَارَكَ اللهُ
doua.translation: « May Allah bless you. »
doua.reference: Ibn al-sounni (#278, p.138). Also see Ibn Qayyim in al-Wabil as-Sayyib (p.304).
doua.phonetic: Wa fîka bârakallah

group.title: On the prohibition of bad omens, bad omens

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا طَيْرَ إِلَّا طَيْرُكَ، وَلَا خَيْرَ إِلَّا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
doua.translation: « O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshiped except You. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (2/220) and Ibn al-Sounni. Al-Albani authenticated it in al-Ahadiths as-Sahiha.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma, lâ <u>t</u>ayra illâ <u>t</u>ayrouka, wa lâ khayra illâ khayrouka, wa lâ ilâha ghayrouka.

group.title: When you take transport, your car or when you ride on an animal

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِيْنَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾ الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللهُ أكْبَرُ، اللهُ أكْبَرُ، اللهُ أكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#2602, 3/34) and at-Tirmidhi (#3446, 5/510). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/156).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi. Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi. Soub<u>h</u>âna l-ladhî sakhkhara lanâ hâdhâ wa mâ kounnâ lahou mouqrinîn, wa innâ ilâ rabbinâ la-mounqalibûn. Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi, Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi, Al<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi. Allâhou akbarou, Allâhou akbarou, Allâhou akbarou. Soub<u>h</u>ânaka l-lâhoumma innî <u>z</u>alamtou nafsî, fa-ghfir lî, fa-innahou lâ yaghfirou dh-dhounûba illâ ant.

group.title: For traver, When traveling, the traveler's doua
group.version: When we go on a trip

doua.arabic:
(١) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِيْنَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِعَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيْفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ المُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
(٢) آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
doua.translation:
(1) Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, How perfect He is, The One Who has placed this (transport) at our service, and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. O Allah, we ask You for birr and taqwa in this journey of ours, and we ask You for deeds which please You. O Allah, facilitate our journey and land us cover its distance quickly. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family, O Allah, I take refuge with You from the difficulties of travel, from having a change of hearts and being in a bad predicament, and I take refuge in You from an ill fated outcome with wealth and family.
Upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition:
(2) « We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. » »
doua.phonetic:
Allâhou akbarou, Allâhou akbarou, Allâhou akbarou. Soubhâna l-ladhî sakhkhara lanâ hâdhâ wa mâ kounnâ lahou mouqrinîn, wa innâ ilâ rabbinâ la-mounqalibûn. Allâhoumma innâ nas-alouka fî safarinâ hâdhâ al-birra wa t-taqwâ wa mina-l-'amali mâ tardâ. Allâhoumma hawwin 'alayna safaranâ hâdhâ wa twi 'annâ bou'dahou. Allâhoumma anta s-sâhibou fî s-safari, wa-l-khalîfatou fî-l-ahli. Allâhoumma innî a'oûdhou bika min wa'thâ i s-safari wa ka âbati-l-manzari, wa soû i-l-mounqalabi fî-lmâli wa-l-ahli.
Au retour, on ajoute :
Âyibûn, tâ ibûn, 'âbidoun, li-rabbinâ hâmidoun.

group.title: Upon entering a town, village, etc...
group.version: When entering a city

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرْاضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيْهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيْهَا
doua.translation: « O Allah, Lord of the 7 heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the 7 earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it. »
doua.reference: al-Hakim (2/100) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him, Ibn al-sounni (#524), al-Hafiz declared it hassan in Takrij al-Adhkar (5/154).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma rabba s-samâwâti s-sab'i wa mâ z<u>z</u>lalna, wa rabba-l-ara<u>d</u>îna s-sab'i wa mâ aqlalna, wa rabba sh-shayâ<u>t</u>îni wa mâ a<u>d</u>lalna, wa rabba r-riyâ<u>h</u>i wa mâ dharayna. As aloukakhayra hâdhihi-l-qaryati wa khayra ahlihâ wa khayra mâ fîhâ, wa a'oûdhou bika min sharrihâ wa sharri ahlihâ wa sharri mâ fîhâ.

group.title: When you enter the markand or the store
group.version: When we Get to the markand

doua.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيْتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3429, 5/291), al-Hakim (1/538) and Ibn Majah (#2235). Al-Albani classified him hassan in Sahih Ibn Majah (2/21) and Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/152).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-<u>h</u>amdou, you<u>h</u>yî wa youmîtou, wa houwa <u>h</u>ayyoun lâ yamûtou, bi-yadihi-l-khayrou, wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîr.

group.title: When the frame stumbles, the car slips ...
group.version: When you stumble or slip

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#4982, 4/296). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (3/941).
doua.phonetic: Bismillâh.

group.title: For the traveler to the resident, say goodbye to his family
group.version: To say goodbye to his family

doua.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ، الَّذِيْ لَا تَضِيْعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
doua.translation: « I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (2/403) and Ibn Majah (#2825, 2/943). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (2/133).
doua.phonetic: Astawdi'oukoumou l-lâha l-ladhî lâ ta<u>d</u>î'ou wadâ i'ouhou.

group.title: Of the resident for the traveler

doua.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِيْنَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيْمَ عَمَلِكَ
doua.translation: « I place your religion, your faith and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (2/7) and at-Tirmidhi (#3443, 5/499). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (2/155).
doua.phonetic: Astawdi'ou l-lâha dînaka wa amânataka wa khawâtima 'amalika.

doua.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
doua.translation: « May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3444). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/155).
doua.phonetic: Zawwadaka l-lâhou t-taqwâ, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara laka-l-khayra <u>h</u>aythou mâ kounta.

group.title: Remembrance while ascending and descending

doua.arabic:
(١) اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
(٢) سُبْحَانَ اللهُ
doua.translation:
When ascending, recite (1) « Allah is the greatest, »
and when descending, recite (2) « How perfect is Allah. »
doua.phonetic:
Allâhou akbar.
Soubhânallâh.

group.title: Prayer of the traveler as dawn approaches

doua.arabic: سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلائِهِ عَلَيْنَا،.رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا عَائِذاً باللهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
doua.translation: « May a witness be witness to our praise of Allah for His favors and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favor on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the Fire. »
doua.phonetic: Samma'a sâmi'oun bi-<u>h</u>amdi l-lâhi, wa <u>h</u>usni balâ ihi 'alayna. Rabbanâ <u>s</u>â<u>h</u>ibnâ wa af<u>d</u>il 'alaynâ 'â idhan billâhi mina n-nâr.

group.title: During a stopover lodging somewhere
group.version: When sleeping under the stars, outdoors

doua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّهِِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
doua.translation: « I take refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil that He has created. »
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou bi-kalimâti l-lâhi t-tâmmâti min sharri mâ khalaq.

group.title: When returning from travel
group.version: When we come back from a trip

doua.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الحَمْدُ، وهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حـَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الأحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
doua.translation: « Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord. Allah fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant, and single-handedly defeated the allies. »
doua.phonetic:
Allâhou akbar, Allâhou akbar, Allâhou akbar.
Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wahdahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-hamdou, wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîroun. Âyibûna, tâ ibûna, 'âbidouna, li-rabbinâ hâmidoun.
Sadaqa l-lâhou wa'dahou, wa nasara 'abdahou wa hazama-l-ahzâba wahdahou.

group.title: After receiving good news or bad
group.version: When we receive good or bad news

doua.arabic:
(١) الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
(٢) الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
doua.translation: Upon receiving good news, say: (1) « All Praise is for Allah by whose favour good works are accomplished. » Upon receiving bad news, say: (2) « All Praise is for Allah in all circumstances. »
doua.reference: Ibn al-sounni in 'Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (#378) and al-Hakim (1/499) and he authenticated it. Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih al Jami' (#4640, 4/201).
doua.phonetic:
Alhamdoulillâhi l-ladhî bi-ni'matihi tatimmou s-sâlihâtou.
Alhamdoulillâhi 'alâ koulli hâlin.

group.title: The merits of praying for the Prophet ﷺ
group.version: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet ﷺ

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «مَنْ صَلَّ عَلَيَّ صَلاةً صَلَّ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشَراً»
doua.translation: The Prophet saws said: « Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma <u>s</u>alli 'alâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ âli mou<u>h</u>ammadin kamâ <u>s</u>allayta 'alâ Ibrâhîma wa 'alâ âli Ibrâhîma. Innaka <u>h</u>amîdoun, majîd. Allâhoumma bârik 'alâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ âli mou<u>h</u>ammadin kamâ bârakta 'alâ Ibrâhîma wa 'alâ âli Ibrâhîma. Innaka <u>h</u>amîdoun, majîd.

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «لا تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِيْ عِيْداً وَ صَلُّوا عَلَيَّ فَإِنَّ صَلاتَكُمْ تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ»
doua.translation: The Prophet saws said: « Do not take my grave as a place of habitual ceremony. Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are. » »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#2042, 2/218) and Ahmad (2/367). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (2/383).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma <u>s</u>alli 'alâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ âli mou<u>h</u>ammadin. kamâ <u>s</u>allayta 'alâ Ibrâhîma wa 'alâ âli Ibrâhîma. Innaka <u>h</u>amîdoun, majîd. Allâhoumma bârik 'alâ mou<u>h</u>ammadin wa 'alâ âli mou<u>h</u>ammadin kamâ bârakta 'alâ Ibrâhîma wa 'alâ âli Ibrâhîma. Innaka <u>h</u>amîdoun, majîd.

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «البَخِيْلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ»
doua.translation: The Prophet saws said: « A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3546, 5/551). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#2787, 3/25) and Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/177).
doua.phonetic: ><u>S</u>alla l-lâhou 'alayhi wa sallam.

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «إنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلائِكَةً سَيَّا حِيْنَ فِي الأرْضِ، يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلامَ»
doua.translation: The Prophet saws: « Allah exalted is He, has got angels scouring the earth to spread the salutations of my community. »
doua.reference: an-Nasai (3/43) and al-Hakim (2/421). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih an-Nasai (1/274).

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «مَا مِنْ أحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ، إلَّا رَدَّ اللهُ عَلَيَّ رُوْحي، حَتَّى أرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامَ»
doua.translation: The Prophet saws said: « Every time somebody greets me, Allah gives me back my soul for me to answer this greeting. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#2041). Al-Albani declared it hassan in Sahih Abi Dawud (1/283).

group.title: The merits of spending the salam
group.version: The reward of saying "assalamu 'alaykum"

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «لا تَدْخُلُوا الجَنَّة حَتَّى تُؤمِنُوا، وَ لَا تُؤمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلَا أدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ إذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُمْ، أَفْشُوا السَّلامَ بَيْنَكُمْ»
doua.translation: « The Prophet saws said: « You shall not enter paradise until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. Shall I not inform you of something, if you were to act upon it, you will indeed achieve mutual love for one another? Spread the Salam amongst yourselves. » »
doua.phonetic: As-salâmou 'alaykoum.

doua.arabic: قَالَ عمار بن ياسر(رضي الله عنه) : «ثَلاثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الإيْمَانَ : الإنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، و بَذْلُ السَّلامِ لِلْعَالَمِ، و الإنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإقْتَارِ»
doua.translation: 'Ammar bin Yasir said: « 3 characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (before hadith #28, 1/82).

doua.arabic: وَ عَنْ عَبْدِاللهِ بِنْ عَمْرٍو(رضي الله عنه) : «أنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أيُّ الإسْلامِ خَيْرٌ؟» قَالَ : «تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرَأُ السَّلامَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَ مَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِف»
doua.translation: 'Abd Allah Ibn 'Amr reported that a man asked the Prophet saws: « Which Islam is the best? » He saws replied, « Feed (the poor), and greand those whom you know as well as those whom you do not. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#12, 1/55) and Muslim (#39, 1/65).

group.title: How to respond salam to a non-Muslim
group.version: Give salam to an infidel kafir

doua.arabic: وَ عَلَيْكُمْ
doua.translation: « And upon you. »
doua.phonetic: Wa 'alaykoum.

group.title: After hearing a rooster crow or a donkey bray

doua.arabic: إذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْألُوا اللهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً، وَ إذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيْقَ الحِمَارِ فَتَعوَّذُوا بِااللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ؛ فَإنَّهُ رَأى شَيْطَانًا
