doua.translation: « If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of a donkey, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil. »
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou billâhi mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni r-rajîm.

group.title: When you hear the barking of dogs
group.version: When we hear dogs barking at night

doua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ
doua.translation: « If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of donkeys at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#5103, 4/327) and Ahmad (3/306). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih Abi Dawud (3/961).
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou billâhi mina sh-shay<u>t</u>âni r-rajîm.

group.title: When you insult someone or mistreat someone
group.version: When someone has treated you badly

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ؛ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إلَيْكَ يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ
doua.translation: « O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, land that be cause to draw him near You on the Day of Resurrection. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma fa-ayyoumâ mou minin sababtouhou, fa-j'al dhâlika lahou qourbatan ilayka yawma-l-qiyâmati.

group.title: When we praise someone's merits
group.version: When we say good things about someone

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «إذَا كَانَ أحَدُكُمْ مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لَا مَحَالَةَ؛ فَلْيَقُل : أحْسِبُ فُلَانًا : وَ اللهُ حَسِيْبُهُ، وَ لَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللهِ أحَداً : أحْسِبُهُ – إنْ كَانَ يَعْلمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَ كَذَا»
doua.translation: « I deem so-and-so to be...and Allah is his reckoner...and I don't praise anyone, putting it (my praising) forward, in front of Allah's commendation, however I assume him so and so(if he knows that of him). »
doua.reference: Muslim (#3000, 4/2296) and al-Bukhari (#2662).

group.title: For those who receive praise
group.version: When you Get compliments

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ [وَ اجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُنُّونَ]
doua.translation: « O Allah, do not punish me for what they say, forgive me for what they do not know (and make me better than what they think of me). »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari in Adab al-moufrad (#761) and al-Albani declared its hassan in Sahih Adab al-moufrad (#585). L'ajout entre crochets est de al-Bayhaqi.
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma lâ tou âkhidhnî bi-mâ yaqûlûna, wa ghfir lî mâ lâ ya'lamoun, [wa j'alnî khayran mimmâ ya<u>z</u>unnûn]

group.title: Talbiya when performing Hajj or Umrah
group.version: Of the labayk talbiya

doua.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ والنِّعْمَةَ، لَكَ وَالمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ
doua.translation: « Here I am O Allah, (in response to Your call), here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner. »
doua.phonetic: Labbayka l-lâhoumma labbayka. Lâ sharîka laka labbayka. Inna-l-<u>h</u>amda wa n-ni'mata laka wa-l-moulkou. Lâ sharîka laka.

group.title: When we pass at the level of the black stone
group.version: When we are in front of al hajar al aswad

doua.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
doua.translation: « Allah is the greatest. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhou akbar.

group.title: Between the Yemeni corner and the Black Stone

doua.arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا في الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وفي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ﴾
doua.translation: « O our Lord, grant us the best in this life and the best in the next life, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1892, 2/179), Ahmad (3/411) and al-Baghawi in Sharh al-sounnah (7/128). Al-Albani declared it hassan in Sahih Abi Dawud (1/354).
doua.phonetic: Rabbanâ âtinâ fî d-dounya <u>h</u>asanatan wa fî-l-âkhirati <u>h</u>asanatan wa qinâ 'adhâba n-nâr.

group.title: When you are on the Safa and Marwa mountains
group.version: When we are on Safa and Marwa

doua.arabic: لَمَّا دَنَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأ : ﴿إنَّ الصَّفَا وَ المَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللهِ﴾«أبْدَأ بِمَا بَدَأ اللهُ بِهِ» فَبَدأ بِالصَّفَا، فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ، حَتَّى رَأَى البَيْتَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ القِبْلَةَ، فَوَحَّدَ اللهَ، وَ كَبَّرَهُ، وَ قَالَ : «لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهٌ وَ حْدَهُ، أنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَ نَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَ هَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ...، الحَدِيْثُ، وَ فِيْهِ : فَفَعَلَ عَلَى المَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا»
doua.translation: « Indeed al-safa and al-Marwah are from the places of worship of Allah. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, Allah is the greatest. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah alone. He fulfilled His promise, aided His Servant and single-handedly defeated the allies.
doua.phonetic:
Vers Safâ : Inna s-safâ wa-l-marwata min sha'â iri l-lâh. Abda u bimâ badaa l-lâhou bihi.
Vers la Ka'ba : Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, Allâhou akbar, Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wahdahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-hamdou, wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîroun. Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou wahdahou. Anjaza wa'dahou, wa nasara 'abdahou, wa hamaza-l-ahzâba wahdahou.

group.title: On the day of Arafat, the dua of Arafat
group.version: The day of Arafat

doua.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ، ولَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3585). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/184) and al-Ahadith as-Sahihah (4/6).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou l<u>h</u>amdou, wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay’in qadîr.

group.title: al-Mash'ar al-Haram, the sacred site
group.version: When we arrive at Mash'ar al Haram during Hajj

doua.translation: « The Prophet saws rode al-Qaswa until he reached al-Mash'ar al-Ḥaram, he then faced the Qiblah, supplicated to Allah, and extolled His greatness and oneness. He stood until the Sun shone but left before it rose. »
doua.arabic: رَكِبَ ﷺ القَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أتَى المَشْعَرَ الحَرَامَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ القِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَ كَبَّرَهُ، وَ هَلَّلَهُ، وَ وَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفًا حَتَّى أسْفَرَ جِدّاً، فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ

group.title: During the stone throw at Jamarat
group.version: Of stoning the stelae with stones

doua.arabic: يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الجِمَارِ الثَّلاثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، وَ يَقِفُ يَدْعُوْ مُسْتَقْبِلَ القِبْلَةَ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الجَمْرَةِ الأوْلَى وَ الثَّانِيَةِ، أمَّا جَمْرَةُ العَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيْهَا، وَ يُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ، وَ يَنْصَرِفُ، وَ لَا يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا
doua.translation: « Allah is the greatest » [with each throw of stones] [Advance towards the Qibla and make invocations by raising your hands, after the first stele and after the second.]
doua.phonetic: Allâhou akbar.

group.title: During a moment of wonder and pleasure
group.version: When you are pleasantly surprised

doua.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ!
doua.translation: « How perfect is Allah! »
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>âna l-lâh.

doua.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
doua.translation: « Allah is the greatest. »
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (#4741, 8/441). Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (2/103, 2/235) and Ahmad (5/218).
doua.phonetic: Allâhou akbar.

group.title: After receiving good news
group.version: When we receive good news

doua.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إذَا أتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ؛ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لله تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى
doua.translation: The Prophet saws would prostrate in gratitude to Allah upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure.
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#2774), at-Tirmidhi (#1578) and Ibn Majah (#1394). Also see Sahih Ibn Majah (1/233) and Irwa' al-Ghalil (2/226).

group.title: When you feel pain in the body
group.version: When it hurts somewhere in the body

doua.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللهِ (ثَلاثاً)
أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ.(سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ)
doua.translation: Recite « In the name of Allah. » (3 times) followed by « I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of. » (7 times). »
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi (3 times). A'oûdhou billâhi wa qoudratihi min sharri mâ ajidou wa u<u>h</u>âdhirou (7 times)

group.title: Against the evil eye
group.version: So as not to wear the eye something or someone

doua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِك عَلَيْهِ
doua.translation: « If you see something from your brother, yourself or wealth which you find impressing, then invoke blessings for it, for the evil eye is indeed true. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (4/447), Ibn Majah (#3509) and Malik (#1697--98). Al-Albani authenticated it in Sahih al Jami' (#556, 1/212).
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma bârik 'alayhi.

group.title: To say when we are surprised, in case of fear
group.version: When you are scared or startled

doua.arabic: لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ
doua.translation: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah. »
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou.

group.title: When you slaughter an animal or offer a sacrifice
group.version: When we sacrifice a beast

doua.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ واللهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ ولَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
doua.translation: « In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, (it is) from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me. »
doua.reference: Muslim (#1966, 3/1557) and al-Bayhaqi (9/287). Ce qu'il y a entre paranthèses est de al-Bayhaqi and d'autres.
doua.phonetic: Bismillâhi wa l-lâhou akbar. [Allâhoumma minka wa laka]. Allâhoumma taqabbal minnî.

group.title: To protect yourself from all harm
group.version: Against the deception and cunning of rebel chayatins

doua.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ، الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ ولَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلقَ، وبَرَأَ وذَرَأَ، ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وِمنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيْهَا، ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الأَرْضِ، ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وِمنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ والنَّهَارِ، ومِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
doua.translation: « I take refuge within Allah's perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made, and originated. (I take refuge) from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. (I take refuge) from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (3/419) with a sahiha chain, Ibn al-sounni (#637). Also see Majma' al-Zawaʾid (10/127).
doua.phonetic: A'oûdhou bi-kalimâti l-lâhi t-tâmmâti l-lâti lâ youjâwaizuhounna barroun wa lâ fâjiroun min sharri mâ khalaqa wa bara a wa dhara a, wa min sharri mâ yanzilou mina s-amâ'i wa min sharri mâ ya'roujouhou fîhâ, wa min sharri mâ dhara a fî-l-ar<u>d</u>i wa min sharri mâ yakhroujou minhâ, wa min sharri fitani l-layli wa n-nahâri, wa min sharri koulli <u>t</u>âriqin illâ <u>t</u>âriqan ya<u>t</u>rouqou bi-khayrin yâ ra<u>h</u>mân.

group.title: To seek forgiveness and repentance
group.version: To ask forgiveness from Allah

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «وَ اللهِ إِنِّي لأسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ وَ أ تُوبُ إلَيْهِ فِي اليَوْمِ أكثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِيْنَ مَرَّةٍ»
doua.translation: The Messenger of Allah saws said : « By Allah, I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day. »

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إلَى اللهِ، فَإِنِّي أتُوبُ إلَيْهِ مِئَةَ مَرَّةٍ»
doua.translation: The Messenger of Allah saws said : « O People, Repent! Verily I repent to Allah, a hundred times a day. »

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «مَنْ قَالَ أسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ العَظِيْمَ الَّذِي لَا إلَهَ إلَّا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ وَ أتُوبُ إلَيْهِ، غَفَرَ للهُ لَهُ، وَ إنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ»
doua.translation: « I seek Allah's forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshiped except He, the Ever Living, the Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, and I turn to Him in repentance. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1517, 2/85), at-Tirmidhi (#3577, 5/569), al-Hakim (1/511) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him. Al-Albani authenticated it, voir Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/182) and al-Jami' al-Ousoul li-Ahadith ar-Rassoul (4/389--390).
doua.phonetic: Astaghfirou l-lâha-l-'a<u>z</u>îma l-ladhî lâ ilâha illâ houwa-l-<u>h</u>ayyou-l-qayyûmou, wa atûbou ilayhi.

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «أقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ العَبْدِ، فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ؛ فَإنْ اسْتَطَعْتَ أنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ؛ فَكُنْ»
doua.translation: « The Messenger of Allah saws said : « The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night, so if you are able to be of those who remember Allah at that time, then be so. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3579), an-Nasai (1/279), and al-Hakim. Also see Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/183).

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «أقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ العَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ، وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ»
doua.translation: The Messenger of Allah saws said : « The nearest a servant is to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so supplicate much therein. »

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «إنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي، وَ إنِّي لأسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ فِي اليَوْمِ مِئَةَ مَرَّةٍ»
doua.translation: The Messenger of Allah saws said: « Verily my heart becomes preoccupied, and verily I seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times a day. »
doua.reference: Muslim (#2702, 4/2075). Also see al-Jami' al-Ousoul li-Ahadith ar-Rassoul (4/386).

group.title: The merits of saying Subhanallah, al Hamdulillah, La ilaha illallah and Allahu akbar
group.version: The reward of dhikr Subhanallah, al Hamdulillah, La ilaha illallah and Allahu akbar

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «مَنْ قَالَ : سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ فِي يَومٍ مِئَةَ مَرَّةٍ، حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ، وَ لَو كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ البَحْرِ»
doua.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. » (100 times daily)
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi wa bi-<u>h</u>amdihi.

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «مَنْ قَالَ : لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ المُلْكُ، وَ لَهُ الحَمْدُ، وَ هُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ، كَانَ كَمَنْ أعْتَقَ أرْبَعَةَ أنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إسْمَاعِيلَ»
doua.translation: Anyone who repeats: « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. » ten times, will be awarded the same reward as the one who freed 4 slaves among the children of Isma'îl. (10 times)
doua.reference: al-Bukhari (7/67) and Muslim (4/2017).
doua.phonetic: Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa<u>h</u>dahou lâ sharîka lahou, lahou-l-moulkou wa lahou-l-hamdou, wa houwa 'alâ koulli shay in qadîr.

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الِميْزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إلَى الرَّحْمَنِ : سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ العَظِيْمِ»
doua.translation: The Messenger of Allah saws said: « There are 2 words (phrases), (which are) light on the tongue, heavy on the scale and beloved to the Most Gracious: ‘How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.’ (and) ‘How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.’ » »
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi wa bi-<u>h</u>amdihi. Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi-l-'a<u>z</u>îm.

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «لَأنْ أقُولَ : سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَ الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ، وَ اللهُ أكْبَرُ، أحَبُّ إلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ»
doua.translation: The Messenger of Allah saws said : « Saying ‘How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest,’ is more beloved to me than everything the Sun has risen over. »
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi, wa-l-<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi, wa lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa l-lâhou akbar.

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «أيَعْجِزُ أحَدُكُمْ أنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ألْفَ حَسَنَةٍ» فَسَألَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ : كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أحَدُنَا ألْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ : «يُسَبِّحُ مِئَةَ تَسْبِيْحَةٍ، فَيُكْتَبُ لَهُ ألْفُ حَسَنَةٍ، أوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ ألْفُ خَطِيْئَةٍ»
doua.translation: The Messenger saws said: « Do any of you think it would be difficult for you to do 1000 good deeds every day?" One person in the audience said, "And how would it be possible to one of us to achieve this? "He answered: It is enough for him to proclaim a hundred times the glory of God for one to register 1000 actions for him and to erase 1000 sins from him. »
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi. (au moins 100 times

doua.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ : «مَنْ قَالَ : سُبْحَانَ اللهِ العَظِيمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ، غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الجَنَّةِ»
doua.translation: « Whoever says: ‘How perfect Allah is, The Supreme, and I praise Him,’ a palm tree is planted for him in paradise. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3464--3465, 5/511), al-Hakim (1/501) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him. Also see Sahih al Jami' (#6429, 5/531) and Sahih at-Tirmidhi (3/160).
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi-l-'a<u>z</u>îmi wa bi-<u>h</u>amdihi.

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «يَا عَبْدَاللهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ، ألَا أدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الجَنَّةِ؟» فَقُلْتُ : بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، قَالَ : «قُلْ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إلَّا بِااللهِ»
doua.translation: The Prophet saws said to Abdillah ibn Qays « Shall I not tell you what constitutes one of the treasures of Paradise? He replied: "Of course, O Messenger of Allah!" And the Prophet then said, "Say: There is no strength or power except in Allah. »
doua.phonetic: Lâ <u>h</u>awla wa lâ qouwwata illâ billâhi.

doua.arabic: قَالَ ﷺ : «أحَبُّ الكَلَامِ إلَى اللهِ أرْبَعٌ : سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَ الحَمْدُ للهِ، وَ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ، وَ اللهُ أكْبَرُ، لَا يَضُرُّكَ بِأيِّهِنَّ بَدَأْتَ»
doua.translation: The Prophet saws said: « The words most appreciated with God are 4:" Glory and purity to Allah, praise to Allah, there is no other god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest. »
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi, wa-l-<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi, wa lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa l-lâhou akbar.

doua.arabic: جَاءَ أعْرَابِيٌّ إلَى رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ : عَلِّمْنِي كَلَامًا أقُولُهُ؟ قَالَ : «قُلْ : لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ وَ حْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللهُ أكْبَرُ كَبِيْراً، وَ الحَمْدُ للهِ كَثِيْراً، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِيْنَ، لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إلَّا بِااللهِ العَزِيزِ الحَكِيمِ»، قَالَ : فَهَؤُلَاءِ لِرَبِّي فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ : «قُلْ : اللهم اغْفِرلِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، واهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي»
doua.translation: A bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah saws and said to him, "Teach me a word that I can repeat." The Prophet saws then recommended him to say: "There is no other god but Allah Alone without an associate, Allah is the Greatest in all His greatness. Praise be to Allah in abundance. Glory and purity to Allah, master of the Universes. He is of power and strength only by Allah, the Mighty, the Wise. "The Bedouin then said," These words are for my Lord. What then becomes of me? "The Prophet saws then added to him to say:" O Allah, forgive me, grant me Your mercy, guide me on the right path and provide me with my subsistence."
doua.phonetic:
Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wahdahou lâ sharîka lahou. Allâhou akbarou kabîran, wa-l-hamdoulillâhi kathîran. Soubhânallâhi rabbi-l-'âlamîna. Lâ hawla wa la qouwwata illâ billâhi-l-'azîzi-l-hakîm.
Allâhoumma ghfir lî, wa rhamnî, wa hdinî, wa rzuqnî.

doua.arabic: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ الصَّلَاةَ، ثُمَّ أمَرَهُ أنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلَاءِ الكَلِمَاتِ : «اللهم اغْفِرْلِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وِ عَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي»
doua.translation: When someone became a Muslim, the Prophet saws taught them to perform prayer and then recommended that they invoke God with these words: « O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health, and grant me sustenance. »
doua.phonetic: Allâhoumma ghfir lî, wa r<u>h</u>amnî, wa hdinî, wa 'âfinî, wa rzuqnî.

doua.arabic: إنَّ أفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ : الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَ أفْضَلُ الذِّكْرِ : لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ
doua.translation: Indeed the best du'a (is): « All praise is for Allah. » and the best remembrance (is): « None has the right to be worshiped except Allah. »
doua.reference: at-Tirmidhi (#3383, 5/462), Ibn Majah (#3800, 2/1249), and al-Hakim (1/503) and he authenticated it and ad-Dhahabi agreed with him. Also see Sahih al Jami' (#1104, 1/362).
doua.phonetic:
Al hamdoulillâh.
Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâh.

doua.arabic: البَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ : سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَ الحَمْدُللهِ، وَ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللهُ، وَ اللهُ أكْبَرُ، وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إلَّا بِااللهِ
doua.translation: « How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshiped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. There is no might nor power except with Allah. »
doua.reference: Ahmad (#513, 3/75) selon l'ordre de Ahmad Shakir and his chain is authentic.
doua.phonetic: Soub<u>h</u>ânallâhi, wa-l-<u>h</u>amdoulillâhi, wa lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhou, wa l-lâhou akbarou, wa lâ <u>h</u>awla wa lâ qouwwata illâ billâhi.

group.title: How the Prophet ﷺ did the tasbih
group.version: Counting the dhikr with the right hand

doua.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْروٍ قَالَ : رَأيْتُ النَّبِيَّ يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيْحَ بِيَمِيْنِهِ
doua.translation: 'Abd Allah ibn 'Amr said : « I saw the Prophet saws make tasbih with his right hand. »
doua.reference: Abu Dawud (#1502, 2/81) and at-Tirmidhi (#3486, 5/521). Also see Sahih al Jami' (#4865, 4/271).

group.title: When night falls and the children play outside

doua.arabic: إذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْل – أوْ أمْسَيْتُم – فَكُفُّوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ؛ فَإنَّ الشَّيَاطِيْنَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِيْنَئَذٍ، فَإذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ، وَأغْلقُوا الأبْوَابَ، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللهِ؛ فَإنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَا يَفْتَحُ بَابًا مُغْلَقًا، وَ أوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللهِ، وَ خَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللهِ، وَ لَوْ أنْ تَعْرِضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئًا، وَ أطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيْحَكُمْ
doua.translation: « When night falls, restrain your children (from going out) because at such time the devils spread about. After a period of time has passed, land them be. Shut your doors and mention Allah's name, for verily the devil does not open a shut door, tie up your water-skins and mention Allah's name, cover your vessels with anything and mention Allah's name and put out your lamps. »
